Result: 在Qwen3-4B上，TwinKV改善了两种策略的大多数配置，对第三种策略接近持平，对第四种接近性能上限的自适应基线仅改善少数配置；在这三种非上限策略中，收益在最宽松压缩比下最小。在RULER上用Llama-3.2-1B时，第四种策略在每个评估单元上都获得改进（因其Alone score仍有大量提升空间）。Llama-3.2-1B在LongBench上的平均增益较小，但在LongBench和LooGLE上的改进单元比例更高，且在RULER上有干净的胜出。此外，少样本分类示例（few-shot classification exemplars）是一种TwinKV在两种模型上均无效的任务结构。

Conclusion: 注意力大小不能作为token因果贡献的可靠代理，这为开发非注意力驱动的KV缓存优化铺平了道路。TwinKV作为一种与策略无关的修复组件，能够在不改变预算和评分规则的前提下提升多种驱逐策略的性能，但其收益依模型、基准和任务结构而异，且存在其不适用的场景（如少样本分类示例）。

Abstract: Long-context inference is bottlenecked by the memory footprint of the key-value (KV) cache, especially for small models under tight resource budgets. Existing KV cache eviction methods score tokens using the model's attention distribution or, in attention-free variants, each key's distance from a global reference point. Using a controlled leave-one-out probe, we find that attention magnitude is unrelated to a token's causal contribution to the answer (Spearman $ρ=-0.004$), challenging the premise behind dominant eviction methods. We introduce TwinKV, a training-free, attention-free redundancy signal that detects whether a token's key has a near-duplicate elsewhere in context. Rather than replacing existing policies, TwinKV acts as a composable repair pass: given a policy's fixed retained set, it identifies evicted tokens with no surviving duplicate (\emph{orphans}) and retained tokens whose information is duplicated elsewhere (\emph{redundant donors}), then swaps them while preserving the original budget and scoring rule. We compose TwinKV with four recent eviction policies across LongBench, LooGLE, RULER, and a short-context MMLU-Pro no-harm control at compression ratios ${0.3,0.5,0.7}$. On Qwen3-4B, TwinKV improves a majority of configurations for two policies, is near-even for a third, and helps only a minority for a fourth adaptive baseline already near a performance ceiling; gains across the three non-ceiling policies are smallest at the loosest ratio. On RULER with Llama-3.2-1B, however, that fourth policy improves in every evaluated cell because its Alone score leaves substantial room to improve. More broadly, Llama-3.2-1B shows a smaller average LongBench gain but a higher fraction of improved cells on LongBench and LooGLE than Qwen3-4B, plus a clean RULER win. We also identify few-shot classification exemplars as a task structure where TwinKV does not help on either model.

</details>


### [190] [Said Aloud, Read Different: Cross-Modal Instability in Multimodal Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27135)
*Basel Mousi,Fahim Dalvi,Shammur Chowdhury,Firoj Alam,Nadir Durrani*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一个面向语音增强的视觉语言对比三元组基准（包含18个中东北非国家、10,150张文化图像），用于评估多模态基础模型在文本vs语音、英语vs阿拉伯语条件下判断的一致性，并发现模态和语言切换会引入三元组级别的不一致性，语音会放大部分失败。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语音优先的助理系统越来越多地依赖多模态基础模型，但语义等价的查询在跨模态（文本vs语音）和跨语言（英语vs阿拉伯语）时是否产生一致的视觉判断仍不清楚，现有聚合准确率指标无法捕捉这种细粒度不一致性。

Method: 构建一个语音增强的视觉接地对比三元组基准，覆盖18个MENA国家共10,150张文化图像，每张图像配对一条受支持陈述和两条似是而非的不受支持备选陈述；定义"对比不稳定性"为模型无法解决三元组内所有陈述的条件概率，从而将片段化推理与完全失败区分开来；在英语和阿拉伯语的文本与语音两种输入模态下评估近期多模态模型。

Result: 发现模态和语言切换会在三元组层面引入显著的不一致性，这种不一致性无法被聚合准确率完全反映；语音输入会放大部分失败（片段化推理）现象。

Conclusion: 现有模型在跨模态、跨语言的视觉推理中一致性不足，尤其是语音输入加剧了不稳定性，该基准已公开供社区使用，以推动对多模态语音助理可靠性的进一步研究。

Abstract: Multimodal foundation models are increasingly used in speech-first assistants that must interpret spoken queries and produce visually grounded decisions. Yet it remains unclear whether semantically equivalent queries yield consistent judgments across modality (text vs. speech) and language (English vs. Arabic). We introduce a speech-augmented visually grounded contrastive triplet benchmark spanning 10,150 culturally grounded images from 18 MENA countries, where each image is paired with one supported statement and two plausible but unsupported alternatives. We define contrastive instability as the conditional rate at which a model fails to resolve all statements within a triplet, isolating fragmented reasoning from complete failure. Evaluating recent multimodal models under text and speech in English and Arabic, we find that modality and language shifts introduce substantial triplet-level inconsistencies that are not fully captured by aggregate accuracy, with speech amplifying partial failures. We make the benchmark publicly available to the community.

</details>


### [191] [STAR : Sentence Translation Alignment Rate for Document-to-Document Machine Translation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27161)
*Yichen Dong,Hao Wang,Junhui Li,Linlong Xu,Longyue Wang,Weihua Luo*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出STAR指标用于量化文档级机器翻译中的句子级结构对齐度，并在此基础上提出StarPO框架，通过动态对齐掩码的偏好优化来聚焦于错位片段的优化，使紧凑模型在翻译质量和结构完整性上超越GPT-4o等大型专有系统。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型推动了从句子级到文档级（Doc2Doc）机器翻译的转变，但单次文档级生成经常出现结构错位问题，表现为句子遗漏或幻觉，违反了源文与译文对应关系的核心要求。

Method: 1) 提出STAR（Sentence Translation Alignment Rate）辅助指标，显式量化句子级结构保真度；2) 基于STAR提出StarPO（STAR-masked Preference Optimization）框架，按结构质量对文档级假设进行排序，并利用动态对齐掩码将优化重点集中在错位片段上。

Result: 在新闻和文学领域的实验表明，StarPO显著提升了翻译质量和结构完整性。尤其值得注意的是，紧凑模型在StarPO的加持下能够超越GPT-4o等大型专有系统，同时保持更优的token效率。

Conclusion: STAR指标和StarPO框架有效解决了文档级机器翻译中的结构错位问题，证明了通过结构感知的偏好优化可以在不依赖超大模型的情况下实现顶尖的翻译性能。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have enabled a shift from sentence-level to document-to-document (Doc2Doc) machine translation, promising improved global coherence. However, document-to-document generation in a single pass frequently suffers from structural misalignment, manifesting as sentence omissions or hallucinations that violate the core requirement of source-target correspondence. To address this, we introduce Sentence Translation Alignment Rate (STAR), an auxiliary metric that explicitly quantifies sentence-level structural fidelity. Building on this, we propose STAR-masked Preference Optimization (StarPO), a framework that ranks document-level hypotheses by structural quality and utilizes a dynamic alignment mask to focus optimization on misaligned segments. Experimental results across news and literary domains demonstrate that StarPO significantly enhances translation quality and structural integrity. Notably, StarPO allows compact models to surpass the performance of massive proprietary systems like GPT-4o while maintaining superior token efficiency.

</details>


### [192] [Prediction of Prediction (PoP): Inter-Layer Activation Fusion for Single-Pass Hallucination Detection in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27165)
*Himal Badu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出PoP（Prediction of Prediction）机制，利用生成过程中模型内部隐藏层的过渡动态来检测事实性错误，无需额外的解码调用或多次采样验证。在TruthfulQA基准上达到75.5%的AUROC，只增加不到1.2%的运行时延。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自回归大语言模型常以高置信度生成事实性错误的内容，限制了其在高风险场景中的应用。现有的输出阶段不确定性指标在面对过度自信的错误断言时会失效，而多采样验证管线又带来显著的内存和延迟开销。

Method: 提出PoP机制，通过融合单次前向传播过程中跨深度的中间隐藏表示，捕获层间转换的不确定性信号，从而在基础前向传播内部检测事实性错误，无需额外的生成解码调用。

Result: 在TruthfulQA基准上，使用自回归transformer主干模型，PoP实现了75.5%的AUROC，且运行时延增加小于1.2%，零额外生成pass。

Conclusion: 隐藏状态层间转换动态可以作为无需额外解码开销的事实性错误信号，PoP提供了一种轻量级的输出阶段不确定性校准替代方案。

Abstract: Autoregressive large language models (LLMs) routinely generate factually incorrect outputs with high decoding confidence, limiting their deployment in high-stakes workflows. Existing output-stage uncertainty metrics can fail when models are overconfident on false assertions, while multi-sample verification pipelines introduce substantial memory and latency overhead. This work evaluates whether internal hidden-state transition dynamics during generation can signal factual errors without auxiliary decoding calls. We introduce Prediction of Prediction (PoP), a mechanism that captures layer-transition uncertainty by fusing intermediate hidden representations across depth during a single forward pass. Evaluated on the TruthfulQA benchmark using autoregressive transformer backbones, PoP achieves an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 75.5% for factual-correctness classification. The mechanism operates within the base forward pass, adding less than 1.2% runtime latency and requiring zero additional generation passes. The numerical results are reported from the author-verified experimental implementation and are bounded by the evaluation scope described below.

</details>


### [193] [When Text Misleads: Inconsistent-Aware Reasoning for Audio-Grounded Dialogue](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27176)
*Yen-Ju Lu,Yuzhe Wang,Yaohan Guan,Xiluo He,Jiarui Hai,Mingrui Liang,Kaavya Chaparala,Thomas Thebaud,Laureano Moro-Velazquez,Najim Dehak,Jesus Villalba*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了ContraTalk基准测试，用于识别和评估口语对话理解中基于文本的捷径（cross-modal disagreement）问题，并提出了Audio Twin框架，将语音转换为可读的声学证据表示以增强语音基础推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的口语对话理解评估常允许基于转录文本或单模态解决方案的捷径，导致模型并未真正基于语音进行推理。作者将这一失败模式形式化为跨模态不一致（cross-modal disagreement），即转录文本暗示看似合理但错误的表面解释，而声学线索（如韵律、说话风格）支持不同的答案。

Method: （1）开发了一个可扩展框架，识别文本偏置的表面解释并将不一致区域转化为冲突QA样本；（2）构建了ContraTalk基准，包含501个问题，覆盖五种对话维度：交互行为、情感状态、对话行为、社会立场和会话意图；（3）提出了Agentic风格的推理框架，将语音转换为Audio Twin（一种文本可读的局部声学线索表示），向推理模型暴露声学证据。

Result: 纯文本LLM在一致案例中准确率超过90%，但在冲突案例中降至33-48%；直接AudioLLM仅提供部分语音基础，在30-40%的冲突案例中仍会选择文本偏置陷阱。Audio Twin框架提高了冲突案例准确率并减少了陷阱选择，但一致案例表现仍依赖骨干模型。

Conclusion: 转录文本捷径是口语对话理解中的重要失败模式；显式的声学证据聚合提供了更可控的接口来诊断和改进语音基础推理。ContraTalk可作为评估和推动语音基础对话推理发展的可靠基准。

Abstract: Understanding spoken dialogue requires joint reasoning over lexical content and paralinguistic acoustic signals such as emotion and conversational intent. However, existing evaluations often allow shortcuts based on transcripts or single-modality solutions, obscuring whether models genuinely ground predictions in speech. We formalize this failure mode as cross-modal disagreement, where transcripts suggest plausible but incorrect surface interpretations while acoustic cues such as prosody or speaking style support different answers. We develop a scalable framework that identifies text-biased surface interpretations and converts disagreement regions into conflict QA examples. We also include consistent cases where transcript-based and speech-grounded interpretations agree, enabling evaluation beyond adversarial audio dependence. This results in ContraTalk, a controlled benchmark containing 501 questions across five discourse dimensions: interaction behavior, emotion state, dialogue act, social stance, and conversational intent. We further develop an agentic-style reasoning framework that converts speech into an Audio Twin, a text-readable representation of localized acoustic cues that exposes acoustic evidence to the reasoning model. Experiments show that strong text-only LLMs exceed 90% accuracy in consistent cases but drop to 33-48% in conflict cases. Direct AudioLLMs provide only partial grounding, still selecting the transcript-biased trap in roughly 30-40% of conflict cases. Our Audio Twin framework improves conflict-case accuracy while reducing trap selection, but its consistent-case behavior remains backbone-dependent. These results identify transcript-based shortcuts as an important failure mode in spoken dialogue understanding and show that explicit acoustic evidence aggregation provides a more controllable interface for diagnosing and improving speech-grounded reasoning.

</details>


### [194] [BALMS: Benchmarking Agentic LLMs for Longitudinal Mental Health Sensing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27219)
*Yu Yvonne Wu,Arvind Pillai,Yuliang Chen,Yuwei Zhang,Sudarshan Regmi,Tess Z. Griffin,Michael V. Heinz,Lisa A. Marsch,Nicholas C. Jacobson,Andrew Campbell*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出BALMS，这是首个用于评估LLM代理系统在纵向心理健康感知任务上能力的基准测试，涵盖3个真实纵向数据集、2类任务（健康评分预测与理由生成）和3种代理范式。研究发现零样本代理通常难以超越简单均值基线，链式思维提示虽然改善推理能力，但无法保证时间接地和数值正确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有心理健康评估依赖 episodic 自我报告量表，只能提供稀疏的健康快照。虽然可穿戴设备和LLM驱动的健康代理能够支持自然语言查询，但现有系统主要处理短期检索式查询，缺乏对长期信号的推理能力来预测健康评分并提供基于证据的理由。该领域缺乏系统性的基准来评估LLM代理在纵向心理健康感知上的表现。

Method: 构建BALMS基准，包含3个真实纵向数据集、2类任务（闭式健康评分预测和LLM-as-Judge自动评分的理由生成），评估3种代理范式在5种开源/闭源LLM主干上的表现。基准设计旨在测试代理是否能够推理长期信号以预测健康评分，并提供有证据支撑的合理解释。

Result: 零样本代理很少能超越简单均值基线，除非使用更强的LLM主干或紧凑的语义特征。链式思维提示能改善推理型主干的表现，但不能保证时间接地性（temporal grounding）或数值正确性。此外，研究还提供了关于效率和时序缩放的进一步分析。

Conclusion: BALMS揭示了纵向心理健康代理所需的关键能力：选择性检索历史数据、接地时间证据，以及在可解释的行为特征上进行推理。当前LLM代理在这些方面仍存在明显不足，该基准为未来纵向心理健康感知系统的开发提供了评估框架和方向指引。

Abstract: Mental health assessment relies on episodic self-report scales, which convert subjective states such as stress into numerical scores but provide only sparse snapshots of wellbeing. Wearable devices offer longitudinal behavioral and physiological signals for continuous, low-burden monitoring. Recent LLM-driven personal-health agents enable natural language queries over wearable signals, but mainly handle short-term, retrieval-based lookups (e.g., highest step count over a week). They do not evaluate whether agents can reason over long-term signals to predict wellbeing scores paired with evidence-grounded rationales. To address this gap, we introduce BALMS, the first systematic benchmark of LLM-based agentic systems for longitudinal mental health sensing. BALMS spans 3 real-world longitudinal datasets, 2 task families (closed-form wellbeing-score prediction and rationale generation auto-graded by an LLM-as-Judge), 3 agentic paradigms evaluated across 5 open- and closed-source LLM backbones. We find that zero-shot agents rarely outperform a simple mean baseline, except with stronger backbones or compact, semantically meaningful features. Chain-of-thought prompting improves reasoning-oriented backbones, but does not guarantee temporal grounding or numerical correctness. Together with more analysis on efficiency and temporal scaling, BALMS highlights the need for longitudinal mental health agents that selectively retrieve history, ground temporal evidence, and reason over interpretable behavioral features.

</details>


### [195] [SCIT: Testing Causal Cache Carriers in Latent Chain-of-Thought Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27265)
*Yi Ding,Lijun Huang,Menglin Yang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出SCIT（后缀缓存交换测试），一种因果协议，通过构造精确的源-接收反事实、修补已声明的缓存片段，识别潜链式思维模型中反事实计算由哪个Transformer对象承载。研究发现算术推理主要通过值缓存后缀轨迹而非隐藏状态传递，并绘制了能力门控的载体图谱。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 潜链式思维（latent chain-of-thought）模型将中间推理从显式文本转移到连续状态中，虽然提高了紧凑性，但隐藏了因果对象（causal object），使得解释中间推理过程的机制变得困难。现有方法难以确定哪个组件真正承载了反事实计算，需要一个系统的因果测试协议来定位。

Method: SCIT结合多种技术：充分性测试（sufficiency tests）、K/V组件拆分（K/V component splits）、隐藏状态控制（hidden-state controls）、语义源控制（semantic source controls）、解码验证（decoded validation）以及匹配损坏（matched corruption）。该方法构造精确的源-接收反事实对，修补声明的缓存段，从而判定哪个Transformer对象承载反事实计算。

Result: 在CODI-GPT2和Sim-CoT风格的GPT-2复现中，反事实算术主要通过值缓存后缀轨迹（value-cache suffix trajectories）而非隐藏状态、键、可复用答案槽或单token触发器传递。主CODI-GPT2检查点获得完整的充分-必要性证据；Sim-CoT风格检查点仅有充分性和解码控制证据，缺乏匹配损坏下的必要性结论。此外，SCIT揭示载体机制随能力切换：算术类GPT-2/1B细胞保留潜尾部值/KV传递，而8B和修复后的非算术细胞通过提示前缀或全缓存K/V路由，边界细胞无明确机制。

Conclusion: SCIT贡献了三层成果：一个缓存级诊断工具、一个检查点特定的GPT-2算术机制结论、以及一个能力门控的载体图谱。该工作明确拒绝"SOTA模型普遍依赖潜尾载体"的普适论断，强调模型能力和局部细胞类型决定了实际推理载体。

Abstract: Latent chain-of-thought models move intermediate reasoning from emitted text into continuous states, improving compactness but hiding the causal object. We introduce SCIT, the Suffix Cache Interchange Test, a causal protocol that constructs exact source-recipient counterfactuals, patches declared cache segments, and identifies which transformer object carries the counterfactual computation. SCIT combines sufficiency tests with K/V component splits, hidden-state controls, semantic source controls, decoded validation, and matched corruption. On CODI-GPT2 and a Sim-CoT-style GPT-2 reproduction, counterfactual arithmetic transfers primarily through value-cache suffix trajectories rather than hidden states, keys, reusable answer slots, or single-token triggers. Complete sufficiency-and-necessity evidence for the late-value-suffix mechanism holds for the main CODI-GPT2 checkpoint; the Sim-CoT-style checkpoint shows the same sufficiency and decoded-control pattern but insufficient matched-corruption evidence for a necessity call. Beyond these local arithmetic cells, SCIT reveals carrier-regime shifts: arithmetic-like GPT-2/1B cells preserve latent-tail value/KV transfer, whereas competent 8B and repaired non-arithmetic cells route through prompt-prefix or full-cache K/V; boundary cells receive no mechanism call. SCIT therefore contributes a cache-level diagnostic, a checkpoint-specific GPT-2 arithmetic mechanism, and a competence-gated carrier map rather than a universal latent-tail claim.

</details>


### [196] [Difference-in-Differences on a Censored Rating Scale Can Manufacture an Effect: Evidence from a Pre-Registered LLM-Judge Audit](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27309)
*Shuyi Fan,Boyuan Deng,Mengyu Xu,Xinhong Xie,Chenyang Li,Hongyang Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文证明了对LLM裁判进行审计时使用的双重差分（double difference）设计在受限评分量表上未被识别：每一对被截断（censored）的项会引入差分衰减（differential attenuation），从而制造虚假的交互效应。作者通过一个预注册的冻结教学裁判审计展示，名义上显著的交互效应(+0.378, p=0.002)实际上完全可由观测到的严重度偏移加量表地板效应在无任何偏好差异的情况下重建79-85%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 审计LLM裁判是否存在偏差通常采用双重差分设计：先在同一裁判内对比两个候选回答，再在某个操纵属性（如学习者画像）上做第二次差分。作者指出这种设计在边界受限的评分量表上存在根本性识别问题——量表的上下限导致每个差分项被各自地截断，截断比例不同会膨胀出虚假的交互效应，从而污染审计结论。

Method: 作者首先从理论上推导双重差分项在有限评分量表上的偏误机制：每个差分项受到自身截断比例的稀释（attenuation），严重度偏移在两个回答上被不平等地截断时就制造出交互效应。随后在冻结的教学裁判上执行预注册审计（990次调用），测量主要终点（陈述的学习者画像对裁判脚手架偏好的效应）与交互项，并从审计自身评分中量化截断机制的贡献。

Result: 预注册主要终点为无效：+0.085分（95% BCa区间[-0.167, +0.353]，p=0.684）。审计中唯一名义显著的交互项+0.378（p=0.002）无法被识别为偏好：仅由观测到的严重度偏移与量表地板效应构造的无偏好数据即可复现其79-85%。

Conclusion: LLM裁判审计中常见的双重差分终点在受限评分量表上不是被识别的偏好度量。审计者必须从自身评分中估计截断机制的贡献，否则会系统性地将差分衰减误读为差分偏好，尤其在"好刺激"（接近量表中段的刺激）恰好处于不同边界距离时。该机制有闭式表达式，且其贡献可从审计自身评分中直接测量。

Abstract: Audits of LLM judges certify a bias by contrasting matched conditions, and the strongest designs difference twice: a within-item contrast between two candidate responses, differenced again across a manipulated attribute, read off a bounded rating scale. We show that this endpoint is not identified on the scale that reports it. Each term of the double difference is censored by its own share, so the observed statistic confounds differential preference with differential attenuation: a severity shift common to both responses manufactures an interaction whenever the two censor it unequally, as unequal distances from the bounds make them, exactly where good stimuli place them. We exhibit the failure inside a pre-registered audit of a frozen pedagogy judge, sealed before the first of its 990 calls. The registered primary endpoint, the effect of a stated learner profile on the judge's scaffolding preference, is null: $+0.085$ points (95\% BCa $[-0.167, +0.353]$, $p = 0.684$). The audit's one nominally significant interaction, $+0.378$ ($p = 0.002$), is not identified as preference: a construction containing zero differential preference reproduces 79 to 85\% of it from the observed severity shift and the scale floor alone. We derive the mechanism in closed form and show that its contribution is measurable from an audit's own ratings.

</details>


### [197] [BTS-AgentBench: A Deterministic, Replayable Pipeline from Read-Only Telemetry Logs to Agent Benchmarks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27334)
*Jeong-Yoon Kim*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种遥测数据到智能体回合任务的构建方法，并实例化为BTS-AgentBench基准。该方法将BTS元数据和原始历史数据规范化为只读工具库，编译出带工具推导的黄金答案与证据的静态任务，并提升为类型化、有界、面向操作员的回合任务。发布532行数据，通过多项质量校验，并成功复现至XAI4HEAT（204个回合，保留测试集完成全部41例）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业站点包含大量只读遥测数据，但缺乏将此类记录编译为可执行的多回合智能体任务的基准，本文旨在填补这一空白，提供一种系统化的遥测到回合构建方法。

Method: 提出telemetry-to-episode构建管线：将BTS元数据和原始历史标准化为只读工具库；利用工具推导的黄金答案和证据编译静态任务；将保留的任务提升为类型化、有界、面向操作员的回合任务。发布包含澄清、目标修订、时间戳策略、质量门控报告和证据归因等特性的532行数据集，并保留原始计算与划分。

Result: 编码契约预检零发现，构建排除控制器完成0/532行；两次独立的原始到回合构建匹配全部11个逻辑工具库导出，并精确复现发布的356/87/89训练/开发/测试划分。将该构建流程应用于XAI4HEAT生成204个回合，在其41行保留测试集上控制器完成0行，保留的GPT-5.5执行完成全部41例。

Conclusion: BTS-AgentBench验证了遥测数据可被系统化地编译为高质量、可复现的多回合智能体基准任务，且该构建路径可泛化到其他数据集（如XAI4HEAT），为工业遥测场景的智能体评估提供了可靠方案。

Abstract: Industrial sites contain large volumes of read-only telemetry, but few benchmarks specify how to compile these records into executable multi-turn agent tasks. We present a telemetry-to-episode construction method instantiated as BTS-AgentBench. The pipeline normalizes BTS metadata and raw histories into a read-only tool store, compiles static tasks with tool-derived gold answers and evidence, and lifts retained tasks into typed, bounded operator-facing episodes. The 532-row release adds clarification, goal revision, timestamp policy, quality-gated reporting, and evidence attribution while preserving the source computation and split. Coded contract preflight reports zero findings, and the construction-exclusion controller completes 0/532 rows. Two independent raw-to-episode builds match all 11 logical tool-store exports and reproduce the released 356/87/89 train/dev/test artifact exactly. Applying the shared construction path to XAI4HEAT produces 204 episodes; on its 41-row held-out test split, the controller completes 0 rows and the retained GPT-5.5 execution completes all 41. Code, artifacts, and replay reports are available at https://github.com/kjy7567/BTS-AgentBench.

</details>


### [198] [Pair-Level Essay-Scale Republication and Reuse from Fragmented Historical Text Reuse: A Workflow Study on Eighteenth-Century Books and Newspapers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27343)
*Ke Shu,Kira Hinderks,Eetu Mäkelä,Mikko Tolonen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究从碎片化的文本重用证据中恢复论文级再版与复用关系，以十八世纪苏格兰哲学家David Hume的散文为中心，将任务形式化为对级证据整合，比较了规则工作流、基线和自动规则适配三类方法。最终工作流在ECCO-ECCO主标注切片上达到0.948 F1，并在ECCO-Newspaper手动审计中确认全部176个预测阳性均为真实的再版或复用案例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究主要关注碎片检索本身，而忽略了更核心的对级证据整合问题。由于输入是碎片化重用命中而非干净的文档对，且正例覆盖率天然不完整，需要将任务重新定义为对级证据整合，以恢复论文级别的再版与复用关系。

Method: 将任务形式化为对级证据整合为合理的传播关系，比较三类方法家族：(1) 分阶段的基于规则的工作流；(2) 基线方法（决策树和两种直接LLM设置）；(3) 自动化规则适配。在标注的ECCO-ECCO切片上评估对级特征聚合的效果。

Result: 对级特征聚合在主标注切片上已达到0.948 F1；最终工作流在测试的规则阶段中给出最强的整体精确率-召回率权衡。直接LLM基线在全量ECCO-ECCO候选集上标记多达14,886对为再版（对比最终工作流的771对），表现为高召回候选扩展器而非精确率受控的分类器。在ECCO-Newspaper上，176个预测阳性全部通过人工审计确认为真实再版或复用。

Conclusion: 在不完整真实标注条件下，可审计的对级证据整合为历史研究提供了一种实用的方法，能够生成紧凑的候选空间供历史学者进行人工检验。

Abstract: This paper addresses the recovery of essay-scale republication and reuse from fragmented text-reuse evidence, a setting whose central challenge is pair-level evidence consolidation and not fragment retrieval alone. The study focuses on a candidate set centered on essays by eighteenth-century Scottish philosopher David Hume, spanning books from ECCO (Eighteenth Century Collections Online) and historical newspapers. Because the input consists of fragmented reuse hits instead of clean document pairs, and positive coverage is inherently incomplete, we formulate the task as pair-level evidence consolidation into plausible transmission relations and compare three methodological families: a staged rule-based workflow, baselines (a decision tree and two direct LLM settings), and automated rule adaptation. On labeled ECCO--ECCO slices, pair-level feature aggregation alone already reaches 0.948 F1 on the main labeled slice, while the final workflow gives the strongest overall precision-recall trade-off among the tested rule stages. On the full ECCO--ECCO candidate universe, direct LLM baselines flag up to 14,886 pairs as reprints compared to 771 for the final workflow, behaving in this direct-prompt setup as high-recall candidate expanders rather than precision-controlled deployment classifiers. On ECCO--Newspaper, manual audit confirms all 176 predicted positives as genuine cases of republication or reuse, while issue duplication and source-side multiplicity reveal additional provenance structure. Under incomplete ground truth, auditable pair-level evidence consolidation provides a practical way to produce compact candidate spaces for historical inspection.

</details>


### [199] [INTENT-AS-A-TOOL Makes it Easy to Track Agentic Misalignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27348)
*Yutong Zhang,Jianshuo Dong,Peng Xu,Long Wang,Jie Zhang,Tianwei Zhang,Xiaoping Zhang,Han Qiu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出INTENT-AS-A-TOOL方法，通过为目标行为添加专用意图工具，以工具调用概率作为无评判器的细粒度信号，追踪LLM智能体在推理过程中的意图变化，从而补充链式推理（CoT）监控，识别关键干预节点以应对智能体错位（agentic misalignment）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM作为自主智能体部署时，安全失败常涉及严重后果行为。现有CoT监控虽能捕捉推理中的意图信号，但事后标注的CoT标签过于粗糙，无法展示生成过程中意图的动态变化，难以支持实时干预。

Method: 引入INTENT-AS-A-TOOL框架：为目标行为添加意图定向工具，为模型提供表达目标行为承诺的专用通道。通过计算意图工具被调用的概率，获得无评判器（judge-free）、细粒度的模型倾向信号，将粗粒度的CoT标签扩展为密集轨迹。

Result: 实验表明INTENT-AS-A-TOOL能够补充CoT监控，将事后CoT标签扩展为密集意图轨迹，并能识别在线干预的关键步骤，证明动作偏好可用于追踪推理过程中的智能体错位。

Conclusion: 动作偏好（action preferences）是追踪智能体错位的有效信号源，意图工具方法为LLM安全监控提供了比CoT更细粒度、可实时干预的替代或补充手段。

Abstract: As large language models (LLMs) are deployed as autonomous agents, safety failures increasingly involve consequential actions. We study agentic misalignment, where agents take harmful actions under goal conflicts and pressures. Using chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring, we find that harmful execution is often preceded by intent signals in reasoning. However, post-hoc CoT labels are too coarse to show how intent changes during generation. We introduce INTENT-AS-A-TOOL, an approach that adds intent-targeted tools to give the model a dedicated channel for expressing commitment to a target behavior. The probability of calling an intent tool provides a judge-free, fine-grained signal of the model's tendency to pursue that behavior. Our results show that INTENT-AS-A-TOOL complements CoT monitoring, expands post-hoc CoT labels into dense trajectories, and identifies critical steps for online intervention. These findings suggest that action preferences are useful for tracking agentic misalignment during reasoning. Our code and data are accessible: https://github.com/RebeccaZhang22/intent-as-a-tool.

</details>


### [200] [RCMN: Understanding Misleadingness in Influential Public Discourse](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27358)
*Peiling Yi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出"以读者为中心的误导性理解"（RCMN）框架，通过五个维度系统刻画公共话语中的误导性；基于该框架构建了证据支撑的数据集，发现误导性远不止捏造事实，还涵盖无依据推断、夸大与省略等机制，并常伴随情绪唤起与歪曲性传播意图；评估五个生成式基础模型后发现，轻量级表示虽能恢复读者层面的解读，但理解误导机制仍需更丰富的上下文与证据信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 有影响力的公共话语不仅通过其陈述内容，还通过信息的框架、省略、情境化与传播方式来误导公众，但现有研究较少关注这种误导性是如何产生以及如何塑造读者解读的。为弥合这一空白，作者提出以读者为中心的研究视角与框架。

Method: 提出RCMN框架，以五个维度操作化误导性：误导机制、可能的读者解读、证据支持的解读、情绪唤起和传播意图；基于该框架构建证据支撑的公共话语数据集；并对五种生成式基础模型进行评测，考察仅基于轻量级声明-上下文表示能否恢复读者中心的误导性理解。

Result: 实证表明误导性具有多样性，远超单纯捏造，常见机制包括无依据推断、夸大和省略，且常与高情绪唤起和歪曲性传播意图相关；评测显示，轻量级表示能较好地恢复读者层面的解读，但识别误导机制仍具较大挑战。

Conclusion: 轻量级表示在可扩展的误导性分析中具有潜力，但对误导机制的可靠理解仍需要更丰富的上下文与证据支撑。

Abstract: Influential public discourse shapes public beliefs and can also mislead, not only through what is stated, but also through how information is framed, omitted, contextualised, and communicated. Yet less research has focused on how such misleadingness arises and shapes the interpretations formed by readers. To address this gap, we introduce Reader-Centric Misleadingness Understanding (RCMN), a framework that operationalises misleadingness through five dimensions: misleading mechanism, likely reader interpretation, evidence-warranted interpretation, emotional arousal, and communicative intent. Based on this framework, we construct an evidence-grounded dataset of influential public discourse. Empirical findings show that misleadingness is diverse and extends well beyond fabrication, with unsupported inference, exaggeration, and omission among the prevalent mechanisms, and is frequently associated with heightened emotional arousal and distortive communicative intent. Moreover, we investigate whether lightweight claim-and-context representations retain sufficient cues for understanding reader-centric misleadingness without access to richer contextual, evidential, and multimodal information. Evaluation across five recent generative foundation models shows that reader-level interpretations can often be recovered from such limited representations, whereas identifying how misleadingness is produced remains considerably more challenging. These findings highlight the potential of lightweight representations for scalable misleadingness analysis, while reliable understanding of misleading mechanisms continues to require richer contextual and evidential grounding.

</details>


### [201] [Your Voice Cloning System is Secretly a Voice Anonymizer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27360)
*Romolo Muletta,Felix Matthias Saaro,Mark Cieliebak,Jan Deriu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出利用现成的XTTSv2多语种声音克隆模型（无需重新训练）进行说话人匿名化。通过条件化伪说话人向量实现语音转换，并引入迭代精炼策略在隐私与实用性之间取得平衡。在七种欧洲语言上实现了接近最优的隐私保护（EER≈0.49），同时保持有竞争力的可懂度和显著优于专用匿名化基线的语音质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 说话人匿名化需要在抑制说话人身份属性的同时保留语言内容和语音质量。现有专用匿名化方法往往在语音质量或跨语言泛化上存在不足，且通常需要大量领域专属训练数据。作者希望利用已有的高质量多语种语音克隆模型，无需重新训练即可实现跨语言的说话人匿名化。

Method: 核心方法是复用XTTSv2（基于27k小时语音训练的多元语音克隆模型）进行匿名化：1) 利用XTTSv2在语音克隆时独立于说话人身份保留韵律结构的能力，通过条件化一个伪说话人向量实现语音转换；2) 提出迭代精炼策略，通过最大化说话人相异度（privacy）与可懂度（utility）的调和平均数来平衡两者。该方法无需任何语言特定的训练。

Result: 在CommonVoice和Multilingual LibriSpeech上的七种欧洲语言评估中，该系统实现了接近最优的隐私水平（EER≈0.49），具有竞争力的可懂度，且语音质量显著优于专用匿名化基线方法。代码已开源。

Conclusion: 实验表明，充分利用现成语音克隆模型的先验能力，可以在不进行领域训练的情况下实现高隐私、高质量的多语种说话人匿名化，为说话人匿名化提供了新的低成本、高泛化性思路。

Abstract: Speaker anonymization suppresses speaker-identifying attributes from speech while preserving linguistic content and quality. We propose repurposing XTTSv2, a multilingual voice cloning model trained on 27k hours of speech, for speaker anonymization without retraining. Our key insight is that XTTSv2's voice cloning capabilities preserve prosodic structure independently of speaker identity, enabling voice conversion by conditioning on a pseudo-speaker. We introduce an iterative refinement strategy that balances privacy and utility by maximizing a harmonic mean of speaker dissimilarity and intelligibility. Evaluated on seven European languages across CommonVoice and Multilingual LibriSpeech, our system achieves near-optimal privacy (EER $\approx$ 0.49), competitive intelligibility, and substantially better speech quality than dedicated anonymization baselines, while requiring no language-specific training. We release the code here: https://github.com/rm00cr/coqui-tts.

</details>


### [202] [Puro-2B: Poor Lab's Qwen2-1.5B Trained on RTX 5090 within $5090](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27370)
*Kairong Luo,Jiarui Cui,Yaorui Yin,Shengqi Chen,Yiming Yang,Linxiang Gao,Yanmohan Wang,Mingzhe Zhang,Kaiyue Wen,Kaifeng Lyu,Wenguang Chen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一套开放、低成本的大语言模型预训练方案，用不到$6.9K的成本在消费级RTX 5090 GPU上以FP8精度从零训练了Puro-2B模型系列（最多1.4万亿token），性能逼近Qwen2.5-1.5B，并发布了完整的训练配方、数据、代码和权重。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型预训练成本高昂（如Llama-3.2-3B超过$1.5M、SmolLM3-3B需要$700K），使得学术界和开源社区难以参与。尽管已有开源权重和训练食谱，但缺乏成本高效、硬件可及且完全开放源码的预训练方案，因此作者致力于降低这一门槛。

Method: 采用一套组合策略实现成本效率：(1) 选择消费级RTX 5090 GPU而非昂贵的数据中心硬件；(2) 使用FP8低精度训练；(3) 超球面优化（hyperball optimization）；(4) 课程模型平均（curriculum model averaging）；(5) 精心设计的数据配方。训练了包含不同token预算和配方变体的Puro-2B模型集合，最多1.4万亿token。

Result: 最佳模型的训练成本低于$6.9K，性能接近Qwen2.5-1.5B。此外推导出Puro Cost Scaling Law，表明约$4.4K即可达到Qwen2-1.5B的性能水平。还通过端到端案例研究考察了预训练数据课程对后训练后下游性能的影响。

Conclusion: 该工作证明了一个重要观点：通过硬件选型、低精度训练和优化策略的合理组合，大规模语言模型预训练可以以极低成本在消费级硬件上实现，这大大降低了学术界和开源社区的参与门槛。作者以Apache 2.0许可发布了完整的预训练配方（数据、代码和权重），使该方案可复现且可进一步研究。

Abstract: Language model pretraining has become almost synonymous with prohibitive cost, placing it out of reach for much of the academic and open-source communities. Although strong open-source efforts already exist, including open-weight models and open-source training recipes, a cost-efficient, hardware-accessible, and open-source pretraining recipe has long been missing. Even at a small scale, training Llama-3.2-3B costs over \$1.5M, and reproducing SmolLM3-3B needs over \$700K. In this report, we present an open pretraining recipe designed to lower this barrier. Using this recipe, we train a collection of Puro-2B models from scratch on up to 1.4 trillion tokens with FP8 precision on consumer-grade RTX 5090 GPUs. The models in the collection differ in token budgets and selected recipe variants. Our best model is trained at a compute cost of less than \$6.9K and approaches Qwen2.5-1.5B performance under our evaluation protocol. This cost efficiency is enabled by a combination of approaches, including hardware selection, low-precision training, hyperball optimization, curriculum model averaging, and the data recipe. Beyond the recipe itself, we provide two additional results. First, across the Puro-2B collection, we derive a Puro Cost Scaling Law that relates training cost to average model performance; the fitted law suggests that about \$4.4K, less than \$5,090, is sufficient to reach the performance of Qwen2-1.5B. Second, as an end-to-end case study, we examine how pretraining data curricula shape downstream performance after post-training. Such controlled studies are enabled by having access to the full pretraining pipeline rather than model weights alone. We release the full training recipe for Puro-2B, including data, code, and model weights under Apache 2.0 at https://huggingface.co/collections/thu-pacman/puro-2b.

</details>


### [203] [D2C-Routing: Dimension-to-Composition Evidence Routing for Mixed-Origin AI-Generated Text Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27380)
*Xin Chen,Fuwei Zhang,Yiqi Tong,Wei Guo,Yutian Xiao,Fuzhen Zhuang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出将AI生成文本检测从二元文档级判断扩展到混合来源文本的"维度到组合"来源归因问题，通过D2C-Routing框架分别推断内容来源与表达来源，再组合成四种协作类型，在MixD2C基准上达到0.8603的四路Avg TPR@1%FPR。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统AI生成文本检测被框定为二元的文档级判断（人类撰写或机器生成），但这种框架对混合来源写作失效——内容起源和表达起源可能不同（例如AI提供内容但人类润色表达）。需要一种更细粒度的检测框架来处理这种混合来源场景。

Method: 提出Dimension-to-Composition Routing (D2C-Routing)框架：先将内容侧和表达侧的证据分别路由到监督的维度头（dimension heads），再用一个学习的门控组合层（gated composition layer）将维度预测组合成最终的分类标签，从而将混合来源检测建模为"维度到组合"的来源归因问题。在MixD2C（从HART混合来源基准重建的分割）上进行评估。

Result: 在MixD2C数据集上，所公开的D2C-Routing检测器系统达到0.8603的四路Avg TPR@1%FPR，比同分割下的RACE-local重跑高出6.5个百分点。核心消融实验支持路由设计，错误分析显示区分"AI内容/人类表达"与"完全AI生成"仍然是最困难的边界。

Conclusion: D2C-Routing通过维度到组合的路由归因方法有效解决了混合来源文本检测问题，性能显著优于基线，并揭示了最难区分的是部分混合（AI内容/人类表达）与完全AI生成文本之间的边界。代码已开源。

Abstract: AI-generated text detection is commonly framed as a binary document-level judgment about whether a text is human-written or machine-generated. This framing breaks down for mixed-origin writing, where content origin and expression origin may differ. We cast mixed-origin detection as dimension-to-composition source attribution, inferring content origin and expression origin before composing them into four collaboration types. We propose Dimension-to-Composition Routing (D2C-Routing), which routes content-side and expression-side evidence to supervised dimension heads before a learned gated composition layer predicts the final label. On MixD2C, a reconstructed split derived from the HART mixed-origin benchmark, our disclosed D2C-Routing-based detector system reaches 0.8603 four-way Avg TPR@1%FPR, 6.5 points above the same-split RACE-local rerun. Core ablations support the routing design, while error analysis shows that distinguishing AI-content/human-expression from fully AI-generated text remains the hardest boundary. Code is available at https://github.com/bystander563/d2c-routing-artifact.

</details>


### [204] [RATIO: A Benchmark for Retrieval Across Typed Ideation Operations in Scientific Literature](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27394)
*Maayan Sharon,Tom Hope*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出RATIO，一个大规模基准测试，用于评估科学文献检索中三种"灵感操作"（ideation moves）：Address（检索解决给定问题的潜在方法）、Broaden（检索更泛化的表述）、Specify（检索具体实例化）。该基准通过扩展话语标记远程监督方法从数百万篇计算机科学全文学术论文中构建，并经过LLM和人工验证。实验表明操作特定的微调能显著提升检索性能，但仍留有改进空间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学文献检索可以为人类和AI科学家提供灵感，但现有检索基准往往只考虑单一类型的相关性（如直接解决问题的方法），忽略了灵感可以发生在不同抽象层级——既可以是直接的方法建议，也可以是更泛化或更具体的方向。需要一个能够捕捉不同抽象层级相关性的检索基准来支持文献驱动的创意生成。

Method: RATIO引入三种"灵感移动"（ideation moves）定义相关性：Address（检索解决给定问题的潜在方法）、Broaden（检索更泛化的表述）、Specify（检索具体实例化）。构建流程包括：将原本仅用于分类的话语标记远程监督扩展到语料库规模检索，从数百万篇CS全文学术论文中构建数据集，并结合大规模LLM筛选和人工审核以确保质量。实验评估了通用检索器和操作特定微调后的检索器在RATIO上的表现。

Result: 实验结果表明，进行操作特定的微调（operation-specific fine-tuning）能显著提升检索器的性能，但当前最佳系统在RATIO上仍有较大提升空间，说明该任务尚未被现有方法充分解决。

Conclusion: RATIO为文献驱动的灵感检索提供了可扩展的训练和评估框架，建立了以三种不同抽象层级操作来定义检索相关性的新范式，为科学灵感检索开辟了新的研究方向。

Abstract: Retrieved scientific literature can serve as inspiration for both human and AI scientists. Inspiration can take different forms: prior work may directly suggest how to address a problem, or surface directions at different levels of abstraction - zooming out to a more general view or zooming in to a concrete realization. We introduce RATIO (Retrieval Across Typed Ideation Operations), a large-scale benchmark in which relevance is defined by three operations which we name ideation moves: Address retrieves potential approaches for stated problems, Broaden retrieves more general formulations, and Specify retrieves concrete instantiations. RATIO is constructed from millions of full-text scientific papers across CS literature via a general recipe that extends discourse-marker distant supervision - previously used only for classification - to corpus-scale retrieval, combined with extensive LLM and human vetting. Experiments show that operation-specific fine-tuning substantially boosts retrievers but leaves much room for further improvements. RATIO provides a scalable training and evaluation framework for retrieval components that support literature-grounded ideation, opening up new research avenues on scientific inspiration retrieval.

</details>


### [205] [Making Clinical Language Models Auditable: Concept-Guided Fine-Tuning for Robust Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27397)
*Jin Mu,Guanhua Chen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出CAST框架，利用稀疏自编码器暴露中间层Transformer特征、以LLM辅助标注和ICD-10约束识别伪影特征，并通过残差减法在微调中抑制这些伪影，从而提升临床文本分类在部署偏移下的鲁棒性和可审计性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床语言模型在院内数据上表现良好，但面对部署偏移时性能下降，原因是模型利用了笔记特定伪影（如模板、分隔符、样板文本）而非真实反映患者状态的临床概念，缺乏可解释性和可审计性。

Method: CAST包含四个核心步骤：(1) 使用稀疏自编码器（SAE）从Transformer中间激活中提取稀疏、人类可审计的特征；(2) 通过LLM辅助解释管道和ICD-10检索约束对SAE潜在特征进行标注；(3) 通过残差减法在微调过程中抑制已验证的伪影潜在特征；(4) 提供事后逐概念归因以审计模型决策。

Result: 在MIMIC-IV出院小结死亡预测任务上，CAST优于对应的微调编码器基线，并与强LLM基线保持竞争力，同时产生特征级审计轨迹，展示支持每个预测的临床概念以及训练中被抑制的伪影概念。

Conclusion: CAST展示了通过显式识别和抑制伪影特征，并保留临床概念级可审计性，可以有效提升临床文本分类模型在分布偏移下的鲁棒性，为部署场景中的安全性与可信度提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Clinical language models can achieve strong in-hospital accuracy yet fail under deployment shifts because they exploit note-specific artifacts (e.g., templates, separators, boilerplate) that do not reflect patient state. We propose CAST (Concept-guided Artifact Suppression Tuning), an SAE-based framework for auditable clinical text classification. CAST uses Sparse Autoencoders to expose sparse, human-auditable features from intermediate Transformer activations, labels SAE latents with an LLM-assisted interpretation pipeline and ICD-10 retrieval constraints, suppresses verified artifact latents via residual subtraction during fine-tuning, and provides post-hoc per-concept attributions for auditing model decisions. On MIMIC-IV discharge-note mortality prediction, CAST improves over its corresponding fine-tuned encoder baselines and remains competitive with strong LLM baselines, while producing a feature-level audit trail of the clinical concepts that support each prediction and the artifact concepts suppressed during training.

</details>


### [206] [How Language Models Organize and Structure Moral Knowledge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27402)
*Orion Reblitz-Richardson*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文通过训练六个独立的线性探针（对应道德基础理论的六个范畴），研究大型语言模型如何组织道德知识。发现道德方向既不完全坍缩为单一检测器，也不彼此孤立，而是跨越高维独立维度同时共享正共同成分（整合的签名），且该几何结构在预训练早期就已形成，其结构反映语料统计而非道德基础理论预测的个体化/约束区分，并展示道德困境方向部分由其构成基础组合而成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有研究表明LLM能检测道德内容，但检测只是低门槛。作者希望探究模型是否更进一步：能否区分不同道德基础（如关心/伤害、公平/欺骗等）并在表征空间中几何地组织它们之间的关系，以理解模型内化道德知识的深层结构。

Method: 在开放权重语言模型上，对MFT六个类别各训练一个独立线性探针，分析所得方向在表征空间中的关系。通过计算成对余弦相似度、维度跨度、共享成分等指标，对比匹配的非道德概念电池，并跨架构、跨规模、遍预训练不同阶段进行验证。此外，扩展至道德困境，分析困境方向与其构成基础的方向组合关系。

Result: 六个道德方向既未坍缩为单一检测器，也未彼此隔离，而是跨越高维独立维度（近最大维数）并共享道德特异性的正共同成分（均值成对余弦0.26对比非道德基线0.013）。该几何一致性跨架构与规模稳定，且在预训练早期即达整合态，早于探针精度饱和。未发现MFT预测的个体化/约束区分（证据不足），结构反映语料统计。道德困境方向部分由其构成基础组合而成（2.7倍于错配基线），但大部分方差编码冲突特异性结构，模型表征的是道德张力本身而非预判。

Conclusion: LLM表征中的道德知识呈现"去独立但整合"的几何组织：六个基础方向共享共同的道德信号，同时保留各自的独立维度。这种结构在预训练中早期固化、跨模型稳定，且由语料统计驱动而非理论预设驱动。模型对道德困境的表示是多层次的——既有来自构成基础的组合信号，也有冲突特有的结构，暗示模型编码的是道德冲突的张力而非预先解决的判断。

Abstract: How do large language models (LLMs) organize moral knowledge? Models detect moral content broadly, but detection is a low bar. We ask whether they go further, distinguishing moral foundations from one another and organizing the relationships between them geometrically.
  We train six independent linear probes on open-weight language models, one per Moral Foundations Theory (MFT) category (care/harm, fair/cheat, lib/oppress, loy/betray, auth/subv, sanc/degrade), and examine how the resulting directions relate to each other in representation space. We find the directions neither collapse into a single moral detector nor isolate from one another. Rather, they span a near-maximal number of independent dimensions while sharing a positive common component. The shared component is the signature of integration, and it is moral-specific relative to a matched non-moral concept battery built identically (mean pairwise cosine 0.26 vs. 0.013).
  The geometry is consistent across architectures and scale and reaches its integration regime early in pre-training, well before probe accuracy saturates. The structure the model discovers shows no evidence of the individualizing/binding distinction predicted by Moral Foundations Theory (an underpowered test: only 20 candidate partitions exist) but rather reflects corpus statistics. Extending to moral dilemmas, each dilemma direction partially composes from its component foundations, at 2.7x a mismatched-pair baseline, while the majority of its variance encodes conflict-specific structure. The model represents moral tension itself, not a pre-resolved judgment.

</details>


### [207] [Consolidating RLVR Capabilities Across Domains: A Deep Dive into Fusion Paradigms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27409)
*Siye Wu,Kai Yang,Yuchen Cai,Xin Xu,Peng-Yuan Wang,Jiaxuan Wang,Jiashun Liu,Jiafei Lyu,Yangkun Chen,Saiyong Yang,Yanghua Xiao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文系统比较了三种将多领域强化学习（RLVR）专家模型融合为统一模型的方法：Merge（合并专家任务向量）、Mix RL（合并数据集重训）和MOPD（多教师在线蒸馏）。通过共享专家和数据、多模型规模及多领域基准测试，发现三者平均性能差异不超过1.4分，但在单一基准上差距可达8.6分，且领域差异与任务向量几何中的跨域关系相关。训练动力学揭示了各自约束，最终给出了按场景选择的实用指南。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多种RLVR融合范式（Merge、Mix RL、MOPD）此前大多被孤立研究，缺乏系统性的横向对比，使得研究者难以判断不同方法在何种场景下更优、如何选择融合策略。

Method: 使用共享的专家模型和数据集，跨模型规模在多领域基准套件上对三种融合范式进行统一比较；分析任务向量几何以解释领域级差异；通过训练动力学揭示各方法的约束条件。

Result: 三种方法平均性能差异不超过1.4分，但单一基准上最大差距达8.6分；领域级波动与跨领域关系（任务向量几何）一致；三种方法均提升单样本准确率且无可见的解决方案覆盖率增益或已持有关键能力损失；训练动力学显示Mix RL依赖领域混合比例、MOPD受限于教师能力、Merge将所有专家更新压缩进一个模型。

Conclusion: 给出了实用选择指南：已有专家且追求低成本融合时用Merge；无专家且需训练统一模型时用Mix RL（需按跨域迁移调整领域比例）；需要保留领域特定增益时用MOPD（即使它无法超越教师或端到端成本更高）。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) improves specific capabilities of large language models, but covering multiple capabilities often involves training separate domain experts and subsequently consolidating them. We organize three fusion paradigms by the artefacts they reuse: Merge combines expert task vectors, Mix RL pools their datasets, and multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) uses both. Because they have largely been studied in isolation, how they compare and how to choose among them remain unclear. We compare all three using shared experts and data across model scales and a multi-domain benchmark suite. Although their average performance differs by at most 1.4 points, the gap reaches 8.6 points on a single benchmark, with domain-level variation tracking cross-domain relations visible in task-vector geometry. Training dynamics expose distinct constraints: Mix RL depends on domain mixture proportions, MOPD remains bounded by its teachers, and Merge compresses all expert updates into one. All three improve single-sample accuracy without measurable gains in solution coverage or losses in held-out capabilities. These results yield a practical guideline: use Merge when experts already exist and cheap fusion is paramount; Mix RL when training a unified model without experts, with domain proportions adjusted for cross-domain transfer; and MOPD when preserving domain-specific gains matters more than surpassing teachers or minimizing end-to-end cost.

</details>


### [208] [Boosting LLM Exploration via Weak-Model Guidance in RLVR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27420)
*Xingyu Shen,Huishuai Zhang,Peng Li,Yinchun Wang,Dongyan Zhao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一种简单有效的方法（使用较弱的较小语言模型生成的部分推理轨迹作为外部前缀）来在RLVR训练中保持LLM的生成多样性，缓解熵塌缩问题，从而提升大k值下的pass@k性能，无需额外的SFT、复杂奖励设计或提示工程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR（带可验证奖励的强化学习）虽然显著提升LLM推理能力，但会导致策略熵下降、推理覆盖范围收窄以及pass@k（大k时）性能退化。现有方法通过算法正则化缓解熵塌缩，但忽略了跨模型非参数化扰动的作用。

Method: 提出外部前缀（outer prefixes）方法：强制目标模型基于由更小、更弱的语言模型生成的部分推理轨迹来生成答案。这些不熟悉的前缀能够有效打断模型的过度自信，鼓励其探索不同的推理路径。该方法不依赖内部探索，而是引入跨模型分布差异来促进探索动力学。

Result: 在多个数学基准上的实验表明，该方法一致优于原始RLVR。性能提升随着k值增大而愈发显著，证明了推理覆盖范围的实质性扩展，同时有效缓解了熵塌缩。

Conclusion: 外部前缀是一种轻量级且高效的策略，通过跨模型非参数化扰动来保持RLVR训练中的生成多样性，为缓解RLVR熵塌缩提供了新的思路，且无需额外的SFT、复杂奖励设计或提示工程。

Abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) significantly improves LLM reasoning but often causes a drop in policy entropy, leading to narrowed reasoning coverage and degraded pass@$k$ for large $k$. While existing methods mitigate this entropy collapse through algorithmic regularizations, cross-model non-parametric perturbation is also neglected. In this work, we propose a simple yet effective approach to preserve the generative diversity of LLMs during RLVR. Instead of relying solely on internal exploration, we force the target model to generate answers based on partial reasoning trajectories generated by a smaller, weaker language models. These unfamiliar prefixes effectively disrupt over-confidence and encourage the exploration of distinct reasoning paths. We empirically study the potential of outer prefixes, revealing the mechanism of the impact of distributional discrepancy to the exploration dynamics in RLVR training. Experiments across multiple mathematical benchmarks show that our method consistently outperforms vanilla RLVR. Notably, the performance gain becomes increasingly pronounced as $k$ scales up, demonstrating a substantial expansion of reasoning coverage. Furthermore, our approach efficiently mitigates entropy collapse without requiring additional SFT, intricate reward designs, or complex prompting.

</details>


### [209] [Stochastic Estimation of Transduced Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27428)
*Vésteinn Snæbjarnarson,Samuel Kiegeland,Manuel de Prada Corral,Ryan Cotterell,Tim Vieira*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于无放回抽样的无偏波束求和算法，用于估计转导语言模型（TLM）的目标前缀概率，相比先前的阈值剪枝波束求和，该方法提供无偏估计并可估计剪枝丢失的质量，在文本和DNA任务上取得更好的计算-方差权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 转导语言模型（TLM）通过将预训练源语言模型与有限状态换能器组合来诱导目标字符串上的语言模型。计算目标前缀概率需要对换能器映射到的所有源字符串概率求和，该集合可能指数级大甚至无限。先前方法使用阈值剪枝波束求和进行近似，只能得到误差未知的下界。

Method: 提出一种无放回抽样的无偏估计方法：从源前缀中无放回重采样，并用包含概率的倒数对每个选中的前缀重新加权。递归应用该校正可得到目标前缀概率的无偏估计，并能估计阈值剪枝造成的质量损失。算法扩展保留的源前缀并采样哪些前缀保留，随着估计加入更多概率质量而减少保留前缀数量，保证以概率1终止。

Result: 在百科文本和DNA上与基于有放回重采样的序贯蒙特卡洛基线对比：在文本上取得更好的计算-方差权衡，在DNA上在相同最大粒子数下取得更低误差。在DNA到氨基酸的转导任务上相较阈值剪枝波束求和减少数个数量级的运行时间，使长目标字符串的前缀概率估计变得可行。在已发表的阅读时间分析中，用无偏采样替换阈值剪枝后，语料惊讶度估计显著降低但结论不变。

Conclusion: 无放回抽样加包含概率倒数重加权的无偏波束求和是计算TLM目标前缀概率的有效方法，既提供无偏估计和误差量化能力，又显著提升计算效率，且不影响下游分析结论。

Abstract: Transduced language models (TLMs) compose a pretrained \emph{source} language model with a functional finite-state transducer to induce a language model over \emph{target} strings. Computing the probability of a target prefix under a TLM amounts to summing the source-model probabilities of all source strings that the transducer maps to target strings beginning with that prefix. This set can be exponentially large or infinite. Prior work uses a computational shortcut based on source prefix probabilities, then approximates the resulting sum with threshold-pruned beam summing. This produces a lower bound with unknown error. Instead, we resample source prefixes without replacement and reweight each selected prefix by the inverse of its inclusion probability. We show that applying this correction recursively gives an unbiased estimator of the target prefix probability and lets us estimate the mass lost by threshold pruning. Our beam-summing algorithm extends the retained source prefixes and samples which prefixes to keep, reducing their number as more probability mass is added to the running estimate. This can save computation and guarantees that the run halts with probability one. We evaluate the method on encyclopedic text and DNA against sequential Monte Carlo baselines that resample with replacement. It achieves a better compute--variance tradeoff on text and lower error at the same maximum number of particles on DNA. On a DNA-to-amino-acid transduction, it reduces runtime by several orders of magnitude relative to threshold-pruned beam summing and makes estimating prefix probabilities for long target strings feasible. Replacing threshold pruning with unbiased sampling in a published reading-time analysis substantially lowers the estimated corpus surprisal but leaves the published conclusions unchanged.

</details>


### [210] [TTPO: Test-Time Policy Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27448)
*Aozhe Wang,Zhengxi Lu,Jianze Wang,Shangke Lv,Ying Liu,Weiming Lu,Jun Xiao,Yueting Zhuang,Hua Yang,Qianglong Chen,Yongliang Shen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出了测试时策略优化（TTPO）方法，利用多数投票伪标签进行无监督的测试时训练，通过对一致rollout进行自蒸馏、对不一致rollout进行分组RL惩罚，并在token级别精细选择，在五个竞赛级数学基准上达到与标签监督OPSD相当的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的后训练方法（如RL和OPSD）在数学推理上取得了显著进展，但依赖ground-truth标签无法进行测试时训练（TTT）。用多数投票伪标签替代真实标签是一种自然方案，但存在关键缺陷：错误的投票会污染教师模型并误导所有token。作者观察到这一失败模式是不对称的——与伪标签不一致的rollout通常是错误的，无论投票本身是否正确，这为设计更鲁棒的伪标签训练目标提供了基础。

Method: TTPO采用非对称目标：对与伪标签一致的rollout通过OPSD进行蒸馏，对不一致的rollout通过分组RL进行惩罚。此外引入token级选择来优化两个分支——蒸馏分支对已收敛位置降低权重，RL分支仅惩罚高置信度的错误。整个框架在无标签条件下通过多数投票路由实现自我监督的逐步收紧。

Result: 在五个竞赛级基准上，TTPO无需任何标签即可匹配标签监督的OPSD性能；在测试时训练中将Qwen3-1.7B从38.0%提升至45.2%；在无思考模式下获得+25.2%至+36.4%的提升；并展现出强大的跨任务泛化能力。

Conclusion: TTPO通过利用伪标签错误的不对称性，成功实现了无监督的测试时训练，在数学推理任务上达到了与标签监督方法相当的性能，证明了在无标签条件下进行有效训练的后训练范式是可行的。

Abstract: Recent prominent post-training methods, such as Reinforcement Learning (RL) and On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD), have driven rapid progress in mathematical reasoning for large language models, yet their reliance on ground-truth labels precludes test-time training (TTT). Replacing ground truth with majority-vote pseudo-labels is a natural alternative, yet it is fragile: an incorrect vote corrupts the teacher and misleads every token. We observe that this failure mode is asymmetric: rollouts that disagree with the pseudo-label are typically wrong regardless of whether the vote itself is correct. Building on this observation, we propose Test-Time Policy Optimization (TTPO), an asymmetric objective that distills agreeing rollouts via OPSD and penalizes disagreeing rollouts with Grouped RL. Token-level selection further refines both branches: distillation down-weights already-converged positions, while RL penalizes only confident errors. Both updates remain well-grounded even under frequent pseudo-label errors, and majority-vote routing yields tighter self-supervision as the model improves. Without any labels, TTPO matches label-supervised OPSD on five competition-level benchmarks, raises Qwen3-1.7B from 38.0% to 45.2% in TTT, yields +25.2% to +36.4% without thinking, and shows strong cross-task generalization.

</details>


### [211] [CritICL: Inference-Time Weak-to-Strong Generalization from Small Language Model Failure Modes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27455)
*Yufan Wu,Yinghui He,Zhengyi Hu,Lang Wei,Ruichen Li,Qifan Yang,Ting Zhu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: CritICL是一种新颖的推理时框架，通过利用弱模型产生的失败模式作为指导信息，以基于批评的上下文示例来提升LLM推理性能，同时比推理时扩展方法需要更少的生成次数和更低的token成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的推理时扩展方法虽然显著提升了LLM的推理性能，但通常依赖重复生成或外部验证，效率较低。作者观察到同一模型家族内不同规模模型之间存在结构化的失败模式，希望将这些看似"不良"的失败输出转化为有价值的指导信号，实现高效的推理改进。

Method: CritICL框架包含两个变体：(1) CritICL-dynamic，自适应地预测输入特定的失败模式并检索相应的批评；(2) CritICL-static，使用全局失败模式配置文件提供稳定的指导。两者都将弱模型导出的失败模式通过基于批评的上下文示例（critique-based in-context examples）整合到推理过程中。

Result: 实验结果显示，CritICL在推理性能上持续优于标准上下文学习（ICL），与推理时扩展（test-time scaling）方法相比达到竞争性或更优的性能，同时显著减少了生成次数和token成本。

Conclusion: CritICL证明了对失败模式的再利用可以成为一种高效的推理增强策略，在保持高推理性能的同时大幅降低计算开销，为推理时优化提供了新的思路。

Abstract: Recent advances in inference-time scaling have significantly improved the reasoning performance of large language models (LLMs). However, these methods typically rely on repeated generation or external verification. To address this limitation, we introduce CritICL, a novel inference-time framework that improves reasoning while maintaining high efficiency. Our key insight is that LLM failure modes exhibit structured patterns across model scales within the same family. Instead of treating failures as undesirable outputs, CritICL leverages them as a source of guidance. Specifically, we utilize failure modes derived from weaker models and incorporate them into inference through critique-based in-context examples. We propose two variants: CritICL-dynamic, which adaptively predicts input-specific failure modes and retrieves critiques, and CritICL-static, which uses a global failure mode profile to provide stable guidance. Experimental results show that CritICL consistently outperforms standard in-context learning and achieves performance competitive with or superior to test-time scaling methods, while requiring significantly fewer generations and lower token cost. Code available at: https://github.com/umwyf/CRITICL

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [212] [EduRiskX: A Neuro-Symbolic Framework with F-Logic Reasoning for Early Academic Risk Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26107)
*Yu Fu,Yongqi Kang,Yong Zhao,Rongfang Bie*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出EduRiskX，一种神经符号框架，结合基于Transformer的时序预测器与F-Logic符号推理，在在线教育学习风险预测中实现高准确率、早期检测能力和可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有在线教育学业风险预测模型存在两个核心问题：早期检测能力有限（往往到较晚阶段才能识别风险学生）以及可解释性不足（"黑箱"模型导致教育工作者信任危机），这两大缺陷严重阻碍了模型在实际教学场景中的部署与应用。

Method: EduRiskX由两部分组成：1) 神经组件——基于时间Transformer的预测器，采用时间注意力建模纵向学生活动序列，结合类别加权损失和动态周截断技术；2) 符号组件——基于F-Logic规则库构建数据驱动专家系统，规则源自教育理论（参与理论与学生整合模型）且仅从训练数据中学习；3) 融合机制——通过逻辑回归将神经风险概率与符号置信度分数进行加权融合。

Result: 在OULAD数据集上采用严格80/10/10学生级别划分，EduRiskX在学期末（第38周）达到0.900准确率和0.894 F1分数，平均早期检测周数为9.32，检测率达94.30%。相较于PatchTST、iTransformer等SOTA时序模型以及LSTM、CNN等深度学习基线，在相同条件下取得了更高的召回率和更早的风险识别。

Conclusion: EduRiskX通过神经符号融合架构有效解决了预测性能与可解释性之间的权衡，不仅提升了早期风险检测能力和预测精度，还通过F-Logic模块提供结构化规则解释，将预测结果与可观察行为模式及教育理论联系起来，增强了模型在真实教育场景中的可信度和实用性。

Abstract: Predicting students' academic risk in online education is crucial for enabling timely interventions that can improve retention and learning outcomes. However, existing models often suffer from limited early detection capability and insufficient interpretability, leading to a "black-box" trust crisis that hinders their adoption in real-world pedagogical settings. To address these challenges, we propose EduRiskX, a neuro-symbolic framework that integrates a temporal Transformer-based predictor with F-Logic symbolic reasoning. The neural component models longitudinal student activity sequences using temporal attention, class-weighted loss, and dynamic weekly truncation. Acting as a data-driven expert system, an F-Logic rule base -- grounded in established educational theories (Engagement Theory and Student Integration Model) to mimic the diagnostic logic of human educators -- is constructed exclusively from the training data. The neural risk probability and the symbolic confidence score are then combined through a logistic regression-based fusion mechanism that learns the relative contribution of each signal. Experiments on the Open University Learning Analytics Dataset (OULAD) using a strict 80/10/10 student-level split show that EduRiskX achieves an accuracy of 0.900 and an F1-score of 0.894 at the end of the semester (Week 38), with an average early detection week of 9.32 and a detection rate of 94.30 percent. Compared with state-of-the-art time-series models (PatchTST, iTransformer) and common deep learning baselines (LSTM, CNN), EduRiskX yields improved recall and earlier risk identification under identical conditions. Beyond predictive performance, the F-Logic module provides structured rule-based explanations linking predictions to observable behavioral patterns and educational theories.

</details>


### [213] [Standalone LLM and a Pre-specified Agentic Pipeline for Explaining ICU Mortality Predictions: a Feasibility Study on the eICU Demo Dataset](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26109)
*Di Zhu,Chen Xie,Haoyun Zhang,Zihan Wei,Ziwei Wang,Jiazhao Shi,Ziyu Wang,Qiyang Xie*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 这是一项修订版可行性研究，比较了独立大语言模型与四步智能体流水线在ICU死亡风险解释中的表现。XGBoost模型在2,353例ICU住院记录上达到AUROC 0.855。在38例解释子集中，智能体流水线消除了明确的结局泄漏，虽然SHAP对齐度和方向一致性较低，但在指南依据和数值特异性上显著更高，提示智能体分解可提升安全相关的可解释性，但需与归因检查结合使用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器学习模型能准确预测ICU死亡率，但特征归因方法单独使用难以提供临床可用的叙述。大语言模型有望弥合这一差距，多步智能体流水线是合理的扩展方向，因其可分离数据解释、指南核查和最终解释三个环节。本研究旨在修正独立与智能体方法间的比较并更明确呈现主要临床发现。

Method: 使用本地eICU Demo数据集（2,353例ICU住院，死亡率8.1%）训练XGBoost模型（AUROC 0.855，AUPRC 0.332）。在分层抽取的38例解释子集上，比较独立LLM与四步智能体流水线的表现；对其中14例与SHAP复核子集重叠的病例，评估SHAP对齐度（Jaccard指数）、方向一致性、指南依据、数值特异性和临床合理性等指标。

Result: 独立LLM产生1例明确结局泄漏，智能体流水线无泄漏。在14例重叠子集中，独立LLM的SHAP对齐度（均值Jaccard 0.171 vs 0.077）和方向一致性（92.9% vs 78.6%）更高；而智能体流水线的指南依据（0.762 vs 0.143）、数值特异性（0.236 vs 0.143）和合理性（0.700 vs 0.671）更高。

Conclusion: 智能体分解可提升安全相关的指南依据和患者特异性细节，但在高风险的ICU死亡风险解释场景中，应将其与基于归因的检查配对使用，以兼顾可解释性与归因准确性。

Abstract: Machine-learning models can predict ICU mortality accurately, but feature-attribution methods alone rarely provide the clinical narrative needed for bedside use. Large language models (LLMs) may bridge this gap, and multi-step agentic pipelines are a plausible extension because they separate data interpretation, guideline checking, and final explanation. This revised feasibility study preserves the original standalone-versus-agentic comparison while making the main clinical findings more explicit. Using the retained local eICU Demo artifact set (2,353 ICU stays; 8.1\% mortality), XGBoost achieved an AUROC of 0.855 (95\% CI 0.796--0.906) and an AUPRC of 0.332 (95\% CI 0.217--0.494). On a stratified 38-case explanation subset, the standalone LLM produced 1 explanation with explicit outcome leakage, whereas the four-step agentic pipeline produced none. Among the 14 cases that overlapped with the SHAP review subset, the standalone LLM showed higher SHAP alignment (mean Jaccard 0.171 versus 0.077) and higher direction consistency (92.9\% versus 78.6\%), while the agentic pipeline showed higher guideline grounding (0.762 versus 0.143), higher value specificity (0.236 versus 0.143), and slightly higher plausibility (0.700 versus 0.671). Clinically, the results suggest that agentic decomposition may improve safety-relevant grounding and patient-specific detail, but it should be paired with attribution-based checks before use in high-stakes risk explanation.

</details>


### [214] [Large Models for Battery Prognostics and Health Management: A Review and Future Roadmap](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26111)
*Jiale Liu,Huan Wang,Weicheng Wang,Rong Zhu,Qiqi Wang,Min Xie*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文首次系统性综述了大语言模型（LMs）在电池健康管理与预测（BPHM）领域的应用，涵盖Transformer架构、自监督预训练、多模态数据集及PEFT等基础技术，并从缓解数据稀缺、增强泛化鲁棒性、融合领域知识实现可解释性、以及系统级自动化四个维度分类梳理了最新进展，同时指出了数据获取、智能验证、可信度及部署可行性等方面的挑战，并提出了未来研究路线图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统BPHM方法（基于物理模型和面向任务的深度学习）在计算效率、参数化、跨域泛化、对大量标注run-to-failure数据的依赖以及模型可解释性方面存在长期瓶颈，亟需新的范式来突破这些限制。

Method: 基于Transformer架构和自监督预训练的大模型（LMs）方法，系统分析其在BPHM中的基础技术与应用，按照四个关键维度（数据稀缺缓解、泛化与鲁棒性增强、领域知识整合与可解释性、系统级自动化）进行分类综述。

Result: 大模型在BPHM中展现出缓解数据稀缺、增强跨域泛化、提升可解释性以及实现系统级自动化的潜力，但同时在数据可获取性、智能验证、可信度保障和部署可行性方面仍存在显著挑战。

Conclusion: 提出未来研究方向路线图，包括构建协作数据生态系统、面向工业应用的智能验证、结合物理知识的可信度增强设计，以及高效的端侧部署方案，以推动下一代具备安全、可靠和自主运行能力的电池管理系统的发展。

Abstract: Battery Prognostics and Health Management (BPHM) is critical for ensuring the safe, reliable, and cost-effective operation of batteries across electric vehicles, grid storage, and consumer electronics. Conventional BPHM approaches, including physics-based models and task-centric deep learning methods, face challenges in computational efficiency and parameterization, cross-domain generalization, dependence on extensive labeled run-to-failure data, and model interpretability. Recent Large Models (LMs), built upon Transformer architectures and self-supervised pre-training, offer a transformative new paradigm to overcome these long-standing bottlenecks. This review provides the first comprehensive survey of LM applications in BPHM, systematically examining how these models address challenges in the field. We begin by elucidating the foundational technologies enabling LMs, including Transformer architectures, self-supervised learning, large-scale multimodal datasets, and PEFT techniques. We then categorize recent progress along four critical dimensions: mitigating data scarcity, enhancing generalization and robustness, integrating domain knowledge for interpretability, and enabling system-level automation. Despite promising results, significant challenges remain across data accessibility, intelligence validation, trustworthiness, and deployment feasibility. To guide future research, we propose a roadmap focused on building collaborative data ecosystems, validating intelligence for industrial applications, enhancing trustworthiness with physics-informed designs, and enabling efficient on-device deployment. This review establishes a systematic approach to understand and advance LM-driven BPHM, providing researchers and practitioners with essential insights for developing next-generation battery management systems capable of safe, reliable, and autonomous operation throughout battery lifecycles.

</details>


### [215] [PICasso: An AI-Enabled Design Framework for Autonomous Optimization of Silicon Photonic Devices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26113)
*Deepak Vungarala,Deniz Najafi,Abdulrahman Aljoudi,Zahra Ghanaatian,Navid Khoshavi,Gourav Datta,Arman Roohi,Mahdi Nikdast,Shaahin Angizi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出PICasso，一个从自然语言描述自动合成、验证和优化光子集成电路（PIC）的AI辅助框架，并引入PIC-Set基准（36个参数化PIC设计任务）来系统评估LLM驱动的光子设计。PICasso通过NL→YAML→GDS结构化生成管线和PDK感知、自动布局布线、DRC/LVS验证及SAX仿真，显著优于vanilla LLM生成，结构Spec@3达92.7%，功能Spec@3达52%，并将插入损耗均值从4.98dB优化到3.25dB。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 光子集成电路设计传统上依赖手动GUI工作流，效率低且专业门槛高。尽管LLM在生成代码和电路描述方面展现了潜力，但直接用于PIC设计时往往产生無法制造或无物理验证的脆性网表。作者希望将结构化的领域约束、物理验证和仿真反馈注入LLM生成过程，使其成为实用的PIC设计代理，并建立统一的基准（PIC-Set）和评估协议来系统衡量AI驱动光子设计的能力。

Method: PICasso采用NL→YAML→GDS的分层生成管线：首先由LLM将自然语言规格转换为结构化YAML描述，注入PDK（工艺设计套件）感知知识；随后自动执行布局与布线（placement and routing），并经过DRC（设计规则检查）/LVS（版图与原理图一致性检查）验证；最后使用SAX库进行光子仿真并提供仿真反馈以迭代优化设计。评估方面，作者构建了PIC-Set基准（36个覆盖核心光子原语和多组件电路的参数化设计任务），提出并采用结构/功能Spec@k、优化效率和扰动鲁棒性等新指标，在统一协议下对多个SOTA LLM进行基准测试。

Result: 在PIC-Set基准上，PICasso相比vanilla LLM生成显著提升了端到端规格满足率：高复杂度电路上结构Spec@3高达92.7%，功能Spec@3达52%。仿真引导优化将电路插入损耗均值从4.98dB降至3.25dB（平均改善1.74dB）。同时PICasso保持了与手动GUI工作流相当的有竞争力的运行时间。

Conclusion: 研究表明，将结构化领域约束、物理验证（DRC/LVS）和仿真反馈融入LLM生成流程，能从根本上将LLM从脆弱的网表生成器转变为实用的PIC设计代理，能够产出可制造版图且运行效率与手动工作流相当。PICasso和PIC-Set为AI驱动光子设计的可扩展、可验证评估提供了坚实基础。

Abstract: We present PICasso, an AI-assisted framework for automated synthesis, verification, and optimization of photonic integrated circuits (PICs) from natural-language specifications. PICasso couples a structured NL -> YAML -> GDS generation pipeline with PDK aware knowledge injection, automated placement and routing, DRC/LVS validation, and SAX-based photonic simulation. To systematically evaluate AI-driven photonic design, we introduce PIC-Set, a benchmark of 36 parameterized PIC design tasks spanning core photonic primitives and multi-component circuits. Using PIC-Set, we benchmark several state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs) under a unified evaluation protocol, including new metrics such as structural and functional $Spec@k$, optimization efficiency, and robustness under perturbations. Across the benchmark, PICasso significantly improves end-to-end specification satisfaction compared to vanilla LLM generation. Structural $Spec@3$ reaches up to 92.7% and functional $Spec@3$ up to 52% on high-complexity circuits. In addition, PICasso consistently reduces circuit insertion loss, lowering the mean loss from 4.98 dB to 3.25 dB (1.74 dB improvement) through simulation-guided optimization. These results demonstrate that structured domain constraints, physical verification, and simulation feedback transform LLMs from brittle netlist generators into practical PIC design agents capable of producing manufacturable layouts with competitive runtimes relative to manual GUI-based workflows.

</details>


### [216] [CIFQA: A Deterministic Tool-Grounded Multi-Agent LLM Framework for Financial Query Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26114)
*Kunjesh Parekh,Anil Kumar Tiwari,Divya Saxena*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出了CIFQA，一个确定性工具支撑的多智能体LLM框架，用于处理计算密集型金融问答任务，在定存查询基准上达到95.54%的计算密集型任务准确率和90.87%的整体准确率，显著优于直接使用LLM的基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 计算密集型金融问答需要精确的结构化推理（如利率、期限、公式和规则约束），但LLM在多步金融计算中常产生数值错误但看似合理的答案。为解决这一局限，需要将语言理解与数值执行分离。

Method: CIFQA采用确定性工具支撑的多智能体框架，将语言理解与数值执行分离。框架包含专用智能体分别负责查询解释、路由、参数提取、计算规划和响应生成，同时使用确定性的Python工具执行金融计算和规则应用。

Result: 在定存查询基准上，CIFQA达到95.54%计算密集型查询准确率和90.87%整体准确率，大幅超越直接使用LLM的基线（即使给基线提供完整公式、利率表和指令）。消融实验表明精确利率查询、期限计算、滚动年调整和提前支取逻辑等确定性组件是关键性能贡献者。使用17B开源模型作为骨干的CIFQA优于更大规模的前沿模型。

Conclusion: 架构设计比模型规模更能决定数值可靠性。CIFQA虽然在定存查询上进行评估，但提供了一个可泛化的计算密集型金融推理框架。

Abstract: Calculation-intensive financial question answering requires exact reasoning over structured rates, temporal conditions, numerical formulas, and rule-based constraints. Although Large Language Models (LLMs) perform strongly on natural language tasks, they often produce numerically incorrect yet plausible answers when solving multi-step financial calculations. To address this limitation, we introduce CIFQA (Calculation-Intensive Financial Query Answering), a deterministic tool-grounded multi-agent LLM framework for financial question answering. CIFQA separates language understanding from numerical execution by assigning specialized agents to query interpretation, routing, parameter extraction, computation planning, and response generation, while deterministic Python-based tools perform financial calculations and rule application. We instantiate CIFQA for fixed deposit query answering and evaluate it on a curated benchmark of fixed deposit queries. CIFQA achieves 95.54% accuracy on calculation-intensive queries and 90.87% overall accuracy, substantially outperforming direct LLM baselines even when provided with complete formulas, rate cards, and benchmark instructions. Ablation studies show that deterministic components such as exact rate lookup, tenure computation, rolling-year adjustment, and premature-withdrawal logic are critical contributors to performance. Notably, a 17B open-source backbone operating within CIFQA outperforms substantially larger frontier models evaluated with the same financial information, demonstrating that architectural design is a more important determinant of numerical reliability than model scale. While evaluated on fixed deposit queries, CIFQA provides a generalizable framework for calculation-intensive financial reasoning tasks.

</details>


### [217] [The Artificial Experimentalist: Discovery and Control of Self-Organizing Phenomena with Autotelic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26116)
*Marko Cvjetko,Benedikt Hartl,Michael Levin,Clément Moulin-Frier,Pierre-Yves Oudeyer*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出基于自诱导强化学习的闭环框架CARL，通过最小局部扰动智能体在Lenia连续元胞自动机中自主发现稳定孤子、控制其运动方向，并支持人类实时引导，展现了零样本泛化能力，为复杂系统的人工实验者智能体开辟了新路径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有探索元胞自动机及复杂系统的方法多为开环模式：设定初始条件、执行完整模拟、观察结果，无法在执行过程中进行干预。这限制了对涌现现象的发现与控制的效率和灵活性。

Method: 采用基于自诱导强化学习（autotelic RL）的闭环框架：智能体自主采样多样化目标，学习目标条件化策略，通过最小局部扰动干预复杂系统。将该框架实例化于Lenia（连续元胞自动机），构建智能体系统CARL。

Result: CARL在三种能力上取得成果：(1)在广泛Lenia更新规则下以高于启发式基线的方法发现稳定孤子；(2)学习用少量干预控制已有孤子的运动方向；(3)人类可通过高层方向指令实时引导孤子穿越迷宫环境。智能体训练于多样目标、更新规则和随机初始状态，其策略可零样本泛化至各种分布外条件。

Conclusion: 研究指向一条通往人工实验者智能体的路径：这类智能体能够在自主或人类引导下，在复杂系统中发现和控制涌现现象。

Abstract: Existing methods for exploring cellular automata and other complex systems mostly operate in open loop: they set initial conditions, execute a full simulation, and observe the outcome, without intervening during execution. We introduce a closed-loop framework based on autotelic reinforcement learning, in which an agent autonomously samples diverse goals and learns a goal-conditioned policy to intervene in a complex system through minimal, local perturbations. We instantiate this framework on Lenia, a continuous cellular automaton known for life-like self-organizing patterns, in an agentic system we call CARL, and demonstrate three capabilities. First, CARL discovers stable solitons across a wide range of Lenia update rules at a higher rate than heuristic baselines. Second, it learns to steer the movement direction of existing solitons with few interventions, showing that CARL can control self-organizing patterns, not only create them. Third, humans can use trained agents to guide solitons through maze environments in real time by specifying high-level directional commands that the agent translates into low-level interventions. Trained across diverse goals, update rules, and random initial states, the agents acquire policies that generalize zero-shot to various out-of-distribution conditions. These results suggest a path toward artificial experimentalist agents that, autonomously or with human guidance, discover and control emergent phenomena in complex systems.

</details>


### [218] [The Accuracy-Efficiency Paradox Quantifying Net Energy Loss in on-Device Energy Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26134)
*Jaeik Jeong,Tai-Yeon Ku,Wan-Ki Park*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文揭示了能源预测领域的"精度-效率悖论"：高精度的能源预测模型可能反而导致净能源赤字，原因是边缘AI推理的能耗和电池老化带来的双重能量损耗。作者提出一个总拥有成本（TCO）框架来最小化净能量损失，将推理能耗与电池老化统一视为能量损失形式，并证明在热敏感的边缘环境中，复杂架构带来的预测精度优势往往被其高运行强度所导致的总能量损失所抵消。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 能源预测的目标是最大化精度以减少能源浪费，但对任务关键的边缘环境（如军事系统）而言，高精度模型在推理时的能耗以及电池老化可能反过来造成净能量赤字，形成"精度-效率悖论"，现有研究忽视了对该悖论的系统性分析。

Method: 提出总拥有成本（TCO）框架，将推理能源消耗与电池老化统一建模为能量损失形式（因退化代表系统未来储能能力的物理耗散），并以净能量损失为优化目标来进行能源预测模型的设计与评估。

Result: 在热敏感的边缘环境中，复杂架构通过更高精度节省的能量，往往小于其所带来的高运行强度导致的总能量损失，验证了TCO框架下精度与效率之间需要重新权衡。

Conclusion: 能源预测模型的设计不应仅以预测精度为唯一指标，而应基于TCO框架综合考虑推理能耗与电池老化，从而在边缘场景中真正实现净能量的最大化保存。

Abstract: Energy forecasting aims to maximize accuracy to ensure energy efficiency by reducing energy waste, an objective that applies equally to on-device forecasting for mission-critical edge environments, including military systems. However, this paper identifies the Accuracy-Efficiency Paradox: high-precision energy forecasting models can ironically trigger a net energy deficit. This stems from both edge AI's inference energy consumption and battery aging. We propose a Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) framework for energy forecasting, designed to minimize net energy loss. This framework treats not only inference energy consumption but also battery aging as a unified form of energy loss, as degradation represents a physical dissipation of the system's future energy-carrying capacity. We demonstrate that in thermally sensitive edge environments, energy saved by the superior precision of complex architectures is often outweighed by the total energy lost through their high operational intensity.

</details>


### [219] [LLMs for Academic Workflows: An Evaluation of Literature Reviews Generated with Short and Long Context Windows of LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26145)
*Muhammad Ali Chaudhry,Xinyuan Hao,Haifa Alwahaby*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究了LLM在短上下文和长上下文设置下生成的文献综述质量，发现AI生成的文献综述需要人工监督才能达到学术出版标准，且随着上下文窗口增大，虽然能纳入更广泛信息并维持连贯性，但内容重复、关键工作遗漏和倾向描述性而非综合性的问题会加剧。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 旨在探究上下文窗口大小对LLM生成文献综述质量的影响，以及AI在支持文献综述写作中的角色，以评估AI生成综述能否满足学术出版标准。

Method: 基于Semantic Scholar和Arxiv的研究来源，由两名研究者从15个维度评估了20篇AI生成的文献综述，对比了短上下文和长上下文两种设置下的生成质量。

Result: AI生成的文献综述需要人工监督才能达到学术出版标准；长上下文虽能整合更广泛信息并维持连贯性，但加剧了内容重复、关键工作遗漏和描述性过强而非综合性的问题。

Conclusion: AI生成的综述可作为基础性概述，但必须由领域专家批判性评估和精炼；未来研究应探索整合其他LLM和微调模型，采用人类专家与AI能力相结合的混合方法来解决已识别的局限。

Abstract: Our research focuses on evaluating literature reviews generated in short and long context settings of large language models (LLMs) to investigate the impact of context window on the quality of AI-generated literature reviews and the role of AI in supporting literature review writing. Twenty AI-generated literature reviews based on research sources from Semantic Scholar and Arxiv were evaluated by two researchers across 15 dimensions. Our findings reveal that AI-generated literature reviews require human oversight to meet academic publishing standards. As context windows increase, LLMs can incorporate broader information and maintain coherence across longer inputs, but they also exacerbate issues such as content repetition, omission of critical work, and a tendency towards descriptiveness over synthesis. Our work shows that AI-generated reviews can provide foundational overviews, but their output must be critically evaluated and refined by domain experts. Future research should consider integrating other LLMs and fine-tuned models in different domains with hybrid approaches that combine human expertise with AI capabilities to address the limitations identified in this study.

</details>


### [220] [Methodological and Conceptual Framework for 5D Multi-Table Analysis: A Unified Approach for Complex Data Reuse](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26149)
*Edouard Lansiaux,Hugo Kazzi,Aurélien Loison,Slim Hammadi,Emmanuel Chazard*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出关系超图Transformer（RHT），一种统一架构，将关系数据库表示为超图，学习五维嵌入（PentE），并执行稀疏关系注意力，其复杂度与平均关系度成正比而非实体数的平方。在Synthea合成电子健康记录数据集上的多标签SNOMED CT代码预测中，RHT在嵌入语义连贯性上优于基线，而XGBoost在罕见代码召回率上表现最佳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多表学习在医疗等领域仍是重大挑战，关系数据同时包含大数据量、高维变量、高基数类别特征、复杂的表间依赖和重复时间观测等多种复杂度来源，需要一种统一的架构来有效处理这些复杂性。

Method: RHT将关系数据库建模为超图，利用五维嵌入（PentE）表示实体，并设计稀疏关系注意力机制，使复杂度与平均关系度成正比而非实体数量的平方。提供了形式化架构定义、注意力复杂度推导和开源参考实现。

Result: 在Synthea数据集上的多标签SNOMED CT条件代码预测任务中，RHT在嵌入语义连贯性上优于表格、关系和时间图基线方法，且计算可扩展。XGBoost在罕见代码召回率上最高。消融研究量化了各架构组件的贡献。

Conclusion: RHT展示了作为多表学习统一架构的潜力，在保持计算可扩展性的同时产生更语义连贯的嵌入。后续将在MIMIC-IV数据集上进行临床验证。

Abstract: Multi-table learning remains a major challenge in machine learning for healthcare and other complex information systems. Relational data combine several sources of complexity, including large data volume, high-dimensional variables, high-cardinality categorical features, complex inter-table dependencies, and repeated temporal observations. We introduce the Relational Hypergraph Transformer (RHT), a unified architecture that represents relational databases as hypergraphs, learns pentadimensional embeddings (PentE), and performs sparse relational attention with complexity proportional to the average relational degree rather than the square of the number of entities. We formally define the architecture, derive the complexity of its attention mechanism, and provide an open-source reference implementation. We evaluate RHT on the public Synthea synthetic electronic health record dataset using multi-label prediction of SNOMED CT condition codes per encounter, a task characterized by high categorical cardinality and long-tailed label distributions. Comparisons with tabular, relational, and temporal graph baselines show that RHT produces more semantically coherent embeddings while remaining computationally scalable. In this benchmark, the highest rare-code recall is achieved by XGBoost, whereas RHT attains the strongest embedding semantic coherence. We also report ablation studies quantifying the contribution of each architectural component. Clinical validation on MIMIC-IV is planned following PhysioNet credentialing. Source code and experimental protocols are provided in the accompanying repository.

</details>


### [221] [Leveraging Large Language Models for Systematic Literature Review of Disease Spread Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26150)
*Orhan Yagizer Cinar,Timur Emre Ozkose,Emma Von Hoene,Amira Roess,Taylor Anderson,Hamdi Kavak*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究开发了一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的流水线，用于从536篇基于智能体建模（ABM）的同行评审论文中自动提取模型相关信息，并与人工系统文献综述（SLR）结果进行比较。GPT-4.1和GPT-5.0的论文级准确率分别约为77.95%和81.67%，字段级准确率从32.40%到100%不等，复杂和主观性字段表现较差。研究发现LLM之间的共识度可作为输出质量的潜在指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 系统文献综述（SLR）通常耗时费力，随着LLM能力的提升，研究者希望探索利用LLM自动化或简化这一过程的可行性，特别是在建模与仿真领域中提取模型相关信息。

Method: 构建了一个LLM流水线，对536篇ABM同行评审论文进行模型相关信息提取，并将提取结果与人工SLR结果进行对比评估，分别报告论文级和字段级准确率，同时分析LLM间一致性与输出质量的关系。

Result: GPT-4.1论文级准确率约77.95%，GPT-5.0约81.67%；字段级准确率范围为32.40%至100%，复杂或主观性字段可靠性较低；LLM高度一致且准确率高时结果可信，低一致性可能暗示幻觉，高一致性低准确率可能反映人工数据集中的噪声或错误。

Conclusion: LLM在SLR中具有应用潜力，能在论文级实现较高准确率，但复杂和主观性字段仍需改进。LLM间共识可作为质量信号，研究为提示词开发和LLM在建模与仿真领域SLR中的实际应用提供了实践见解。

Abstract: Recent advancements in Large Language Models (LLMs) have created new opportunities to streamline and potentially automate many research processes, including systematic literature reviews (SLRs). This study reports an LLM pipeline development for extracting model-relevant information from 536 peer-reviewed agent-based modeling papers. We compare the results with those of a human-conducted SLR. Our results show paper-level accuracies of approximately 77.95% for GPT-4.1 and 81.67% for GPT-5.0. Field-level accuracy ranges from 32.40% to 100.00%, with more complex or subjective fields performing less reliably. Importantly, we find that agreement between LLMs is a potential indicator of output quality: low agreement may signal hallucinations, whereas high agreement combined with low accuracy may point to noise or errors in the human dataset. Overall, our study provides practical insights into prompt development and highlights both the potential and limitations of using LLMs for full-scale SLRs in the modeling and simulation domain.

</details>


### [222] [Explainable Artificial Intelligence for Customer Churn Prediction in Telecommunications: A Framework for CRM Integration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26151)
*Sandeep Gaddamwar*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对电信客户流失预测模型因不可解释性而难以落地于CRM挽留工作流的问题，在IBM电信客户流失数据集上基准测试了四种分类器（逻辑回归、随机森林、XGBoost、LightGBM），证明其性能接近（AUC在0.831-0.841之间），并提出了一个四层CRM集成架构，将风险评分与SHAP/LIME归因向量转化为分层细分、挽留行动模板和再训练反馈闭环，预计可将总流失率降低3.3-5.3个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高精度的流失预测模型（如集成及非线性架构）因其黑箱特性被排除在CRM前端工作流之外——挽留专员仅凭概率分数无法设计个性化干预措施。论文旨在弥合预测准确性与可解释性之间的鸿沟，使模型输出能直接支撑一线挽留决策。

Method: 在IBM Telco数据集（7,043条记录，19个特征，通过SMOTE将训练集平衡至50%流失率）上基准测试逻辑回归、随机森林、XGBoost和LightGBM四种分类器，采用AUC-ROC和准确率评估并通过5折交叉验证确认差异显著性；随后提供全局SHAP排序（识别任期、总费用、月付合同为主导信号）和实例级SHAP/LIME分解；最后提出四层CRM集成架构，将风险分数与归因向量映射到分层细分、结构化挽留行动模板及再训练反馈循环。

Result: 逻辑回归取得最强AUC-ROC（0.8411），LightGBM取得最高准确率（78.42%）；四种模型AUC差距在0.011以内（0.831-0.841），交叉验证表明领先模型在统计上基本持平。瞄准最高风险五分之一客户群体，预计可削减总体流失率3.3-5.3个百分点，每轮活动周期保留约$199K-$319K收益。

Conclusion: 在电信流失预测场景中，简单可解释模型（逻辑回归）与复杂黑箱模型性能无显著差异，因此无需牺牲可解释性换取准确率。结合SHAP/LIME归因和四层CRM集成架构，可构建一套从预测到行动再到反馈的完整可落地的流失挽留系统。

Abstract: Subscriber attrition is a costly, persistent challenge for telecommunications providers, with monthly churn of roughly 1.9% in mature markets eroding billions in revenue annually. Predictive models can flag at-risk customers accurately, yet they are routinely excluded from frontline CRM workflows because high-performing ensemble and non-linear architectures are opaque: a retention specialist cannot design a personalised intervention from a probability score alone, without knowing why a subscriber is at risk. This paper addresses that gap.
