With 140 samples and 50% label noise, the PINN reduces the relative configuration error, equilibrium residual, and closed-chain residual by 67.88%, 67.35%, and 88.06%, respectively. Using the full dataset, the PINN achieves 0.1597% relative configuration error with an inference time of 0.1773 ms, compared with 17.97 s for an iterative nonlinear solver. Experimental fine-tuning reduces the marker RMSE from 2.657 mm to 0.497 mm and increases R2 from -0.788 to 0.937. These results demonstrate accurate, physically consistent, and computationally efficient static shape estimation of closed-chain CCRs.

</details>


### [387] [Dispersive Forward Tree Search for Optimal Control: Coverage, Complexity, and Computation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26314)
*Shashank A. Deshpande,Jonathan P. How*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于前向传播的动力学规划器DFT*，针对微分平坦非线性系统，通过局部色散控制指令的前向树实现确定性有限样本近最优性保证，并采用成本条件支配剪枝使树规模在时间水平上达到多项式级别，在多类机器人平台上展现了优于现有方法的解质量与并行可扩展性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于转向（steering）的规划器需要求解状态到状态的边界值问题（BVP），对非线性平台而言往往难以求解。前向传播避免了转向需求，但相关规划器的有限样本行为缺乏理论刻画，且实际实现性能不佳。因此需要一种既有理论保证又实用的前向传播动力学规划方法。

Method: 在微分平坦非线性系统的大类中，构建局部色散控制指令的前向树，证明该树在认证的树规模下包含近最优轨迹。为控制仿射系统提供构造色散指令集的一般机制。提出成本条件支配剪枝过程，在保持近最优性的同时使树规模在时间水平上呈多项式增长。实现广度优先扩展的搜索算法DFT*，并为独轮车、拖车和四旋翼设计高效色散采样器，同时支持并行硬件加速和receding-horizon实现。

Result: DFT*在嵌入式处理器上与最先进的动力学规划器在相近求解时间内提供持续有竞争力且往往明显更优的解质量，并随并行计算规模扩展而加速。在receding-horizon循环中实现了动态环境下的实时规划。

Conclusion: 本文首次为基于传播的动力学规划器提供了确定性的有限样本近最优性保证，同时通过成本条件支配剪枝解决了前向树规模指数爆炸的难题，并证明了该方法在实际平台上的高效性与可扩展性，为无转向的动力学规划提供了理论基础与实用算法。

Abstract: Steering-based planners require solutions to state-to-state boundary value problems, which can be inaccessible for nonlinear platforms. Forward propagation evades the steering requirement, but the finite-sample behavior of the associated planners remains uncharacterized and their implementations underperform in practice. This paper develops a propagation-based kinodynamic planner with deterministic finite-sample near-optimality guarantees. We work within the large class of differentially flat nonlinear systems and show that a forward tree of locally dispersive control commands contains a near-optimal trajectory at a certified tree size. We provide a general mechanism to construct dispersive command sets for control-affine systems, which are necessary to implement the search algorithm prescribed by the theory. We show that covering the certified trajectory class irrespective of cost provably demands a tree exponentially sized in the problem horizon, and present a cost-conditioned dominance pruning procedure that retains near-optimality at a tree size polynomial in the horizon. We implement the resulting search algorithm, Dispersive Forward Tree search (DFT*), as breadth-first expansion of the forward tree, which maps naturally onto parallel hardware. We design efficient dispersive samplers for the unicycle, the trailer car, and the quadrotor and evaluate challenging planning tasks for these platforms. DFT* delivers consistently competitive and often substantially better solution quality than state-of-the-art kinodynamic planners at comparable solution times on embedded-tier processors, accelerating further as parallel compute is scaled. We also implement DFT* in a receding-horizon loop to demonstrate real-time planning in dynamic environments at embedded-tier compute budgets.

</details>


### [388] [Cross-Platform Benchmark of Neural 3D Reconstruction for Autonomous Laboratory Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26383)
*Yongho Kim,Mengjiao Han,Victor Mateevitsi,Silvio Rizzi,Michael E. Papka,Nicola Ferrier*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文系统性地对神经3D重建方法（NeRF和3D高斯溅射）在实验室机器人实际运行的计算平台上进行了基准测试，并对比了Meta的SAM3D单图重建方法。结果表明高斯溅射在渲染质量上优于NeRF但GPU开销更大，机载计算无法满足交互速率的全场景优化需求；SAM3D能在数秒内生成合理物体几何但细节存在偏差。研究建议采用分层管线，以轻量级前馈重建维持实时感知-跟踪回路，同时选择性调度重型神经重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主实验室机器人依赖3D重建管线将原始相机流转化为可操作的物体表征，且必须满足物理控制回路的延迟预算。然而神经3D重建方法在实验室机器人实际运行的计算平台上的实时可行性尚未被充分表征，缺乏系统性的计算平台基准评估。

Method: 作者在从单板计算机到服务器级节点的多种GPU计算设备上，系统性地对NeRF和3D高斯溅射的训练与渲染进行了计算平台基准测试，并从延迟和保真度两个维度将Meta的SAM3D单图重建方法与每场景优化（per-scene optimization）方法进行对比评估。

Result: 研究发现：(1) 高斯溅射在渲染质量上优于NeRF，但需要更大的GPU开销；(2) 机载计算资源不足以支撑全场景优化在交互速率下运行；(3) SAM3D能在数秒内生成合理的物体几何，但存在可能影响下游操作任务的细节不匹配问题。

Conclusion: 研究结果支持采用分层管线架构：以轻量级前馈重建来维持实验室机器人实时感知与跟踪回路，同时根据计算资源条件选择性地调度更重的神经重建方法，以平衡实时性与重建质量。

Abstract: Autonomous robots performing laboratory tasks depend on 3D reconstruction pipelines that can turn raw camera streams into actionable object representations within the latency budget of a physical control loop. Neural 3D reconstruction methods have demonstrated high-quality view synthesis, but their real-time viability across the compute platforms on which laboratory robots actually run remains poorly characterized. In this work, we present a systematic compute-platform benchmark of neural 3D reconstruction methods, evaluating NeRF and 3D Gaussian Splatting training and rendering on GPU-enabled computing devices ranging from single-board computers to server-class nodes, and place Meta's SAM3D single-image reconstruction on the same axes to quantify its latency and fidelity gap relative to per-scene optimization. Our results show that Gaussian Splatting yields higher rendering quality than NeRF at greater GPU cost, and that onboard compute is insufficient for full per-scene optimization at interactive rates. Our preliminary assessment on SAM3D indicates that it delivers plausible object geometry within seconds, but with detail mismatches that can compromise downstream manipulation. Together, these findings motivate tiered pipelines in which lightweight feed-forward reconstruction sustains the real-time perception-and-tracking loop for laboratory robots, while heavier neural reconstruction is scheduled selectively on suitable compute.

</details>


### [389] [RTNav: Towards Real-Time Zero-Shot Object Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26496)
*Easop Lee,Lingyu Zhang,Boyuan Chen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出RTNav，一种将推理延迟、异步环境步进和有界计算作为显式设计考虑的实时零样本目标导航架构，在HM3D实时变体上相比现有方法最高提升11%的成功率和5.1点的SCT（按完成时间加权的成功率）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有零样本目标导航方法多在同步模拟器中开发，其中环境会等待智能体行动，推理时间被默认为零成本。然而在真实世界中，视觉-语言基础模型引入的推理延迟不可忽略，当智能体需要持续运行于真实环境时，顺序执行感知-推理-行动的架构会因时间预算压力而出现性能大幅退化。

Method: RTNav将推理延迟、异步环境步进和有界计算作为显式设计考虑，提出一种简单但有效的架构，在实时运行条件下重新设计感知、推理和行动的执行流程，以适应真实世界的时间约束。

Result: 在HM3D-v1、HM3D-v2和HM3D-OVON的实时变体上，RTNav相比先前的零样本目标导航方法，成功率最高提升11%，成功率按完成时间加权（SCT）最高提升5.1个点。

Conclusion: 同步模拟器中的评估忽略了推理延迟的影响，导致现有方法在真实时间条件下性能严重退化；将时间约束作为显式设计因素可以显著改善实时目标导航的性能，为机器人导航系统的实际部署提供更可靠的方案。

Abstract: Navigation in unknown environments to find unforeseen objects has become increasingly feasible with capable vision and language foundation models. However, these models also introduce non-negligible inference latency, which becomes an important concern when agents must operate continuously in the real world. Most state-of-the-art methods are still developed in synchronous simulators, where the environment waits for the agent to act and inference time is effectively free. As a result, agents are often designed around the sequential execution of perception, reasoning, and action, with little regard for time constraints. Under real-time execution, where wall-clock time counts towards the task budget, the inefficiencies of these architectures become clear. We show that recent zero-shot object navigation methods suffer consistent performance degradation under such realistic timing conditions. Motivated by this observation, we propose RTNav, a simple but effective architecture that treats inference latency, asynchronous environment stepping, and bounded compute as explicit design considerations. Evaluated on real-time variants of HM3D-v1, HM3D-v2, and HM3D-OVON, RTNav improves the success rate by up to 11% and the Success weighted by Completion Time by up to 5.1 points over prior work.

</details>


### [390] [Closing the Loop on the Poppy Humanoid: Bipedal Locomotion with Linear-Quadratic Control and Learned Cost Functions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26505)
*Xulin Chen,Borui He,Ruipeng Liu,Naveed Tahir,Zhenyu Gan,Garrett E. Katz*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于线性二次调节器（LQR）框架的闭环行走控制器，用于开源低成本机器人Poppy Humanoid。通过从开环行走轨迹的播放数据中学习二次代价函数，该方法显著提高了双足步行的可靠性，并在实验中证明了相对于开环轨迹播放的统计显著改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Poppy Humanoid是一款开源、低成本、适合AI研究与教育的机器人，但尚无公开方法能在标准硬件上实现可靠、无需辅助的双足行走。这是该领域的空白，亟需填补。

Method: 基于LQR框架设计闭环跟踪控制器：首先使用名义行走轨迹进行开环播放收集数据，然后从这些数据中学习一个二次代价函数，用于构建LQR控制器，从而改善轨迹跟踪的可靠性。

Result: 在实证验证中，闭环控制器相比开环轨迹播放表现出统计显著的行走性能改进，证明了所提方法的有效性。

Conclusion: 该工作为Poppy Humanoid提供了一种可复现、功能完整的闭环双足行走控制方案，弥补了该硬件平台上可靠自主行走方法的缺失，并展示了从开环数据学习代价函数来构建LQR控制器的可行性。

Abstract: The Poppy Humanoid is an open-source, low-cost robot suitable for research and education in artificial intelligence. However, we are unaware of any published methodology that achieves reliable, unassisted bipedal locomotion on the standard Poppy hardware. This paper contributes a functional closed-loop walking controller for Poppy, based on the linear-quadratic regulator (LQR) framework for trajectory tracking. Starting with data collected from open-loop playback of a nominal walking trajectory, our proposed method learns a quadratic cost function for an LQR controller that substantially improves the reliability of the motion. The closed-loop controller is validated empirically, demonstrating statistically significant improvements in walking performance compared to open-loop trajectory playback.

</details>


### [391] [Memory Anchors for Continual Robot Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26545)
*Maximilian Du,Zhanyi Sun,Chen Xu,Paarth Shah,Masha Itkina,Shuran Song*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文发现回放缓冲区中仅一小部分"记忆锚点"经验对防止灾难性遗忘至关重要。这些锚点位于新旧任务表征发生坍缩但动作冲突的区域，剔除10%的记忆锚点会导致LIBERO基准上遗忘率增加4.5倍以上，而富集这些锚点可将高冲突任务的遗忘降低63%，并在真实机器人上实现连续学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人在真实场景中部署需要持续学习新任务而不遗忘已有行为。常见的回放缓冲区缓解灾难性遗忘方法假设所有过往经验同等重要，但作者发现实际上只有少量经验对保持过去性能起决定性作用，因此需要识别并理解这些关键经验。

Method: 作者在表征空间中识别新旧任务观测表征发生坍缩（collapse）的区域，这些区域中新旧任务虽然需要冲突的动作指令，但表征却高度相似。将这些区域中的旧任务经验定义为"Memory Anchors"。通过对比剔除这些锚点与随机剔除等量样本的效果，以及向缓冲区中富集这些锚点来验证其作用。

Result: 仅剔除10%的记忆锚点再采样缓冲区，LIBERO基准上灾难性遗忘增加4.5倍以上；在缓冲区中富集记忆锚点可使高冲突任务的遗忘降低63%，并在真实机器人上成功实现两个任务序列的连续学习。

Conclusion: 回放缓冲区中并非所有旧数据都同等重要，记忆锚点（即新旧表征坍缩但动作冲突区域的旧数据）在防止旧知识被破坏性覆盖中起关键作用。有针对性地识别并保留或富集这些锚点，可以显著提升机器人持续学习的稳健性。

Abstract: Robot policies deployed in the wild should have the capability to continually learn new tasks without forgetting existing behaviors. A common approach to combat such catastrophic forgetting is to train on new task data with a replay buffer of previously learned task data. Although this buffer is commonly sampled randomly from all prior experiences, we show that a small set of these experiences contributes greatly in anchoring past performance. We call these experiences Memory Anchors. We identify Memory Anchors in regions where representations of new-task observations collapse onto those of old-task observations even though the tasks require conflicting actions, like when a familiar object must be manipulated in a new way. Rehearsing old data in this region plays a key role in preventing destructive overwriting of past task knowledge, serving as this critical Memory Anchor role. Excluding only 10% Memory Anchors before sampling the buffer leads to more than a 4.5x increase in catastrophic forgetting on the LIBERO benchmark suites. Conversely, enriching the replay buffer with Memory Anchors can decrease high-conflict task forgetting by 63% and enables successful continual learning of two task sequences on a real robot. Videos and additional visualizations can be found at https://robot-adaptation.github.io/MemoryAnchors

</details>


### [392] [TrapVLA: Trapping Vision-Language-Action Models in Configured Failure Modes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26578)
*Jun-Hui Liu,Kun-Yu Lin,Yi-Lin Wei,Xu-Han Chen,Yinghao Li,Zhuohao Li,Yuan-Ming Li,Qing Zhang,Xiaoyi Fan,Dongmei Jiang,Yan Li,Wei-Shi Zheng*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了"配置化故障诱捕"（Configured Failure Trapping）这一新型后门攻击任务，针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，通过隐蔽的文本触发器激活攻击并诱导配置化的故障模式（如让机器人以指定位置偏移抓取），而非仅追求任意任务失败。作者构建了数据引擎和自动化评估套件，创建了Trap-LIBERO和Trap-RoboTwin两个基准，并提出TrapVLA方法，通过显式学习触发器诱导的动作残差将策略引向配置化故障行为，实验证明其在仿真和真实机器人场景中均能有效注入配置化故障且保持干净数据上的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有针对VLA模型的后门攻击仅将任何任务失败视为攻击成功，无法精细控制机器人故障的方式。作者旨在提出一个更具挑战性、更难以检测的新攻击范式——配置化故障诱捕，要求攻击者精确控制机器人如何失败（如指定抓取的位置偏移），填补该领域研究的空白。

Method: 首先提出数据引擎，用于合成高质量的靶向轨迹；其次设计自动化评估套件以度量配置化故障的保真度；在此基础上构建两个基准Trap-LIBERO和Trap-RoboTwin，覆盖四种代表性故障模式；最后提出TrapVLA方法，识别出稀疏动作偏差这一关键挑战，通过显式学习触发器诱导的动作残差来将策略导向配置化故障行为。

Result: 在仿真基准和真实机器人场景的广泛实验中，TrapVLA能有效将配置化故障模式注入VLA模型，同时在干净数据上基本保持原有性能，验证了方法的有效性和攻击的隐蔽性。

Conclusion: 配置化故障诱捕是一种比传统后门攻击更难检测、更具威胁的攻击范式。TrapVLA证明了这一攻击的可实现性，并提供了相应的基准与工具，为VLA模型的安全研究奠定了重要基础。

Abstract: This work introduces Configured Failure Trapping, a novel backdoor attack task against Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, which aims to activate attacks through stealthy textual triggers and induce configured failure modes. Unlike prior backdoor attacks that treat any task failure as a successful attack, Configured Failure Trapping requires the attacker to control how the robot fails (e.g., causing the robot to grasp with a specified positional offset), making it substantially more challenging and hard to detect. To support the new task, we propose an effective data engine for synthesizing high-quality target trajectories and an automated suite for measuring configured-failure fidelity. Then, based on this foundation, we construct two new benchmarks, namely Trap-LIBERO and Trap-RoboTwin, that instantiate Configured Failure Trapping across four representative failure modes. To address this task, we identify sparse action deviation as a critical challenge and accordingly propose a novel method named TrapVLA, which explicitly learns trigger-induced action residuals to steer the policy toward the configured failure behavior. Extensive experiments across simulation benchmarks and real-world robotic settings show that TrapVLA effectively injects configured failure modes into VLA models while largely preserving performance on clean data. Project page: https://john-liua.github.io/TrapVLA/

</details>


### [393] [SOLO: Stable Omni-terrain Long-Horizon Perceptive Humanoid Locomotion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26583)
*Pihai Sun,Gang Han,Jingkai Sun,Jiahao Ma,Zeran Su,Zelin Tao,Peiran Liu,Shuai Shi,Wei Cui,Zifan Wang,Jialin Yu,Wen Zhao,Kangning Yin,Jiaxu Wang,Jiahang Cao,Lingfeng Zhang,Hao Cheng,Jian Tang,Yijie Guo,Qiang Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: SOLO是一个统一的感知-控制框架，通过查询重建器（QR）和轨迹感知MSE（TA-MSE）蒸馏两个核心组件，解决了人形机器人在长时程复杂地形穿越中因感知与控制误差累积导致的脆弱性问题。在仿真中高度图L1误差降低3.3-4.0倍，在压力测试地形上达到97.5%的平均穿越成功率和96%的踏脚石成功率，并在零样本部署下仅使用胸部深度相机和本体感觉完成1.5公里户外路线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人形机器人虽然能在复杂地形上长距离行走，但现有的感知人形策略会随着感知与控制误差的累积而变得脆弱。作者识别出两个导致长时程脆弱性的根源：(1)稠密地形重建会平滑掉对动作至关重要的细节；(2)逐点模仿缺乏时间维度的信用分配，无法将未来的惩罚传播到之前的动作上。

Method: SOLO包含两个核心组件：(1)查询重建器（Query Reconstructor, QR）：利用傅里叶编码的单元查询从深度-本体感觉token中检索空间上具体的证据，保持尖锐的地形边界；(2)轨迹感知MSE（TA-MSE）蒸馏：在PPO奖励中加入下一状态的师生不一致惩罚，使广义优势估计（GAE）能够将未来的不一致惩罚传播到之前的动作，实现时间维度的信用分配。

Result: 在仿真中，QR将高度图L1误差降低了3.3-4.0倍；TA-MSE在课程进展上超越了PPO和MSE+PPO。在压力测试地形上，SOLO达到97.5%的平均穿越成功率和96%的踏脚石成功率，而稠密重建变体仅为75.0-75.6%和0-3%。零样本部署时，仅使用胸部深度相机和本体感觉即可完成1.5公里户外连续路线和室内混合地形课程。

Conclusion: 针对长时程复杂地形穿越任务，同时解决感知重建中的细节丢失和控制中的时间信用分配问题，可以显著提升人形机器人策略的鲁棒性，并且该框架能够零样本迁移到真实世界长距离部署。

Abstract: Humans traverse complex terrain over long distances without losing balance, whereas perceptive humanoid policies become fragile as perception and control errors accumulate. We present SOLO, a unified framework addressing two compounding causes of this long-horizon fragility: dense terrain reconstruction smooths action-critical details, and pointwise imitation lacks temporal credit assignment. Its Query Reconstructor (QR) uses Fourier-encoded cell queries to retrieve spatially specific evidence from depth-proprioception tokens, preserving sharp terrain boundaries. Trajectory-Aware MSE (TA-MSE) Distillation adds next-state teacher-student disagreement to the PPO reward, enabling Generalized Advantage Estimation to propagate future disagreement penalties to preceding actions. In simulation, QR reduces height-map L1 error by factors of 3.3-4.0, while TA-MSE surpasses PPO and MSE+PPO in curriculum progression. On stress-test terrains, SOLO achieves 97.5% mean traversal success and 96% stepping-stone success, versus 75.0-75.6% and 0-3% for dense-reconstructor variants. Deployed zero-shot with only a chest-mounted depth camera and proprioception, SOLO completes a continuous 1.5-km outdoor route and an indoor mixed-terrain course. Project page: https://sunpihai-up.github.io/solo/

</details>


### [394] [Relaxation-Aware Multimodal Sensing of Soft Gripper Driven by Structure-Perception-Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26622)
*Yanzhe Wang,Hao Wu,Ziyi Zheng,Huixu Dong*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种集成结构-感知-学习的软体抓手框架，通过变刚度设计、视觉与红外热成像感知、以及温度耦合的物理信息学习模型，在280秒力控抓取保持任务中将力的平均绝对误差降至0.066N，比固定孔径和仅瞬时基线分别提升80%和95%，实现了稳定持续的软体抓取。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 软体手在抓取保持过程中，由于高分子材料的固有粘弹性导致应力松弛和抓取力持续衰减，难以实现稳定、持续的抓取。受人类抓取中相位依赖刚度调节与连续感知反馈的启发，需要解决这一根本性挑战。

Method: 提出一个集成的结构-感知-学习框架：(1) 变刚度软体抓手，采用机载视觉和红外热成像实时跟踪变形与温度场；(2) 提出温度耦合的粘弹性力表征，结合物理信息学习模型重构力趋势，并在保持阶段提供显式力补偿。

Result: 在280秒力控抓取-保持任务中，该方法将期望力维持的平均绝对误差降至0.066N，相较固定孔径基线和仅瞬时补偿基线分别提升80%和95%的性能。

Conclusion: 结果支持"机制-人工智能协同设计"的观点：机制结构决定了可行的交互范围，而学习算法补偿粘弹性动力学中的残余不确定性，两者结合可实现稳定、持续的软体抓取。

Abstract: Achieving stable, sustained grasping with soft robotic hands remains a fundamental challenge. Compliance enables safe and adaptive contact, yet the intrinsic viscoelasticity of soft polymers leads to stress relaxation and a continuous decay of grasping force during holding. Inspired by human grasping, which combines phase-dependent stiffness regulation with continuous sensing and feedback, this paper presents an integrated structure--perception--learning framework. We develop a variable-stiffness soft gripper that uses onboard vision and infrared thermography to track deformation and the temperature field in real time, preserving continuous tracking of the interaction state. To mitigate relaxation-induced force decay, we propose a temperature-coupled viscoelastic force representation, together with a physics-informed learning model, to reconstruct the force trend and provide explicit compensation during holding. Experiments show that, in a 280s force-controlled grasp-and-hold task, the proposed method maintains the desired force with a mean absolute error of 0.066N, outperforming fixed-aperture and instantaneous-only baselines by 80% and 95%, respectively. Overall, the results support a mechanism--AI co-design view: mechanisms shape feasible interactions, while learning compensates remaining uncertainty in viscoelastic dynamics, together enabling stable, sustained grasping.

</details>


### [395] [FLARE: A Failure-Aware Framework for Autonomous Correction and Recovery in Visual-Language Robotic Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26645)
*Ganlong Zhao,Zijia Tang,Xingping Chen,Zhanghui Kuang,Ye Tian,Guanbin Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出FLARE框架，通过"Retry"（重试）和"Reset"（重置）两种机制赋予视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）错误恢复能力，使其能够在接触丰富的机器人操作任务中应对执行偏差和状态破坏性故障，显著提升任务成功率和鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的VLA模型通常仅在"完美"的、无失败的轨迹演示上训练，导致其在面对常见执行错误（如抓取失败、物体掉落、意外碰撞）时无法恢复，性能表现脆弱。

Method: FLARE框架包含三大核心组件：（1）"Retry"机制：通过在演示中注入扰动和桥接片段，将机器人位姿与环境状态解耦，使策略能够自主处理执行偏差；（2）"Reset"管线：利用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）对执行视频进行离线故障分析，自动识别分布外（OOD）状态，并针对性地收集少量以物体为中心的"Reset"技能库，训练以恢复任务有效状态；（3）推理阶段：在线MLLM监视器在任务执行与"Reset"技能之间进行仲裁。

Result: 在具有挑战性的接触丰富操作任务上进行实验，结果表明FLARE框架显著提升了任务成功率和系统鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 通过将"重试"式的偏差自主修正与"重置"式的状态恢复相结合，并利用MLLM进行离线/在线双重监控，FLARE为VLA模型提供了实用的错误恢复能力，是提升长时程操作任务可靠性的有效途径。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action Models~(VLAs) have demonstrated significant promise in generalizing to complex, long-horizon robotic manipulation tasks. However, their performance remains brittle, as they are typically trained on trajectory-monotonic, failure-free demonstrations. This reliance on ``perfect" data leaves them unable to recover from common execution errors, such as a missed grasp, a dropped object, or an unexpected collision. In this paper, we propose FLARE, a novel framework that endows VLAs with robust error recovery capabilities through a ``Retry" and ``Reset" paradigm. First, we introduce a ``Retry" mechanism by injecting perturbation and bridging segments that decouple robot pose from environment state into demonstrations, enabling the policy to autonomously handle execution deviations. Second, to address critical, state-breaking (OOD) failures, we introduce a ``Reset" pipeline. We leverage an MLLM for offline failure analysis to automatically identify OOD states from execution videos. This analysis enables the efficient, targeted collection of a small library of object-centric ``Reset" skills, which are trained to restore the environment to a task-valid state. Our full framework integrates these learned policies. At inference, an online MLLM monitor arbitrates between task execution and ``Reset" skills. Experiments on challenging, contact-rich manipulation tasks show our approach significantly improves task success and robustness.

</details>


### [396] [Beyond the Proving Ground: Independent Public-Road Testing of Assisted Lane Change Systems using LiDAR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26669)
*Marcello Cellina,Akos Kriston,Antonio Migneco,Davide Maggi,Stefano Favelli,Fabrizio Re,Fabrizio Minarini,Andrea Nuovo,Riccardo Dona,Biagio Ciuffo*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种在公共道路上独立测试商用高级驾驶辅助系统（ADAS）辅助车道变换功能的方法，使用配备LiDAR检测与跟踪系统的测试车辆在法国A31高速公路上进行测试。在27个预定义变道操作中，18个完成、9个被抑制，其中有6个操作未满足UNECE R79法规的最小安全距离要求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 商用ADAS测试对确保安全性和合规性至关重要，但现有的试车场场景无法反映真实道路驾驶的复杂性，而地理围栏（geo fencing）方法需要制造商协作且限制评估独立性，因此需要一种独立的、可在公共道路上进行的方法来测试辅助车道变换系统。

Method: 在法国A31高速公路上开展测试活动，测试车辆配备基于LiDAR的车辆检测与跟踪系统，涵盖测试车辆与接管车辆之间不同车距和车速的组合。使用实时动态全球导航卫星系统（RTK GNSS）接收器评估检测与跟踪性能，并将记录的车道变换轨迹与UNECE第79号法规的车道变换抑制要求进行比较。

Result: 在27个预定义变道操作中，18个完成、9个被系统抑制。其中6种情况下系统允许了不符合法规最小距离要求的操作，3种情况下在考虑测量不确定性后偏差仍具有统计显著性。这是首次旨在评估辅助车道变换系统符合R79安全距离要求的公共道路测试活动，结果表明LiDAR传感适用于此目的。

Conclusion: 所提出的方法可以支持市场监督和未来法规修订，通过揭示型式认证程序中未涵盖的真实世界行为，为ADAS的独立合规性评估提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Testing of commercial Advanced Driver Assistance Systems is essential to ensure safety and compliance during type approval and in service operation. However, proving ground scenarios may not reflect real world driving complexity, while geo fencing can require manufacturer collaboration and limit assessment independence. This work presents a methodology for independently testing Assisted Lane Change systems on public roads. A campaign on the A31 French motorway used a test vehicle equipped with a LiDAR based vehicle detection and tracking system. Tests covered combinations of inter vehicle distance and speed between the test vehicle and the take over vehicle. Real time kinematic global navigation satellite system receivers assessed detection and tracking performance. Recorded lane change trajectories were compared with the lane change suppression requirements of UNECE Regulation Number 79. Of 27 predefined lane change manoeuvres, 18 were completed and 9 suppressed. In 6 cases, the system allowed manoeuvres that did not meet regulatory minimum distance requirements. In 3 cases, the deviation remained statistically significant after accounting for measurement uncertainty. To the authors knowledge, this is the first public road campaign designed to assess Assisted Lane Change compliance with Regulation Number 79 safety distance requirements. The results demonstrate the suitability of LiDAR based sensing for this purpose. The methodology can support market surveillance and future regulatory revisions by revealing real world behaviours not covered by approval procedures.

</details>


### [397] [PredVLA: A Sub-Million-Parameter Predictive-Coding Policy for Robot Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26673)
*Hiroki Sawada,Shunichi Kasahara*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: PredVLA是一个仅含68万可训练参数、无需机器人数据预训练的语言条件预测编码策略，在LIBERO基准上达到86.9%（短时域）和75.4%（含长时域）的平均成功率，显著优于同等参数规模的Transformer和LSTM策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前主流机器人操作基准由大规模预训练的视觉-语言-动作模型主导，但模型规模是否是实现强语言条件控制的必要条件尚不明确。作者希望探索小参数预算下是否仍可通过不同的控制架构保持竞争力。

Method: PredVLA采用语言条件的预测编码策略，通过分层生成性循环动力学预测视觉特征与本体感觉，观测仅通过在线推理的感官预测误差影响潜在状态。这种预测编码公式使观测驱动的纠正确实可量化——禁用推理即可得到精确的开环控制条件。模型仅含0.68M可训练参数，无需机器人数据预训练。

Result: 在LIBERO基准上，PredVLA在三个短时域套件上达到86.9%平均成功率，纳入长时域套件后为75.4%。在与相同冻结前端、示范、动作解码器和评估协议的受控对比中，PredVLA的平均成功率分别是参数匹配的Transformer的3.7倍和LSTM的7.4倍。

Conclusion: 亚百万参数的循环生成策略能在现代语言条件操作基准上实现强性能，同时提供基于预测误差驱动的在线状态修正的显式机制，表明大模型规模并非实现强语言条件控制的必要条件。

Abstract: Large pretrained vision-language-action models dominate modern robot-manipulation benchmarks, but it remains unclear how much model scale is necessary for strong language-conditioned control, or whether fundamentally different control architectures can remain competitive at much smaller parameter budgets. We present PredVLA, a language-conditioned predictive-coding policy with only 0.68 million trainable network parameters and no robot-data pretraining, whose hierarchical generative recurrent dynamics predict visual features and proprioception while observations influence latent state only through online inference from the resulting sensory prediction errors. On LIBERO, PredVLA achieves an 86.9% mean success rate across the three short-horizon suites and 75.4% when the long-horizon suite is included. Under a controlled comparison using the same frozen front end, demonstrations, action decoder, and evaluation protocol, PredVLA achieves 3.7x and 7.4x mean success rates of parameter-matched Transformer and LSTM policies, respectively. The predictive-coding formulation also makes the contribution of observation-driven correction directly measurable: because observations influence the recurrent state only through prediction-error-based latent inference, disabling this inference yields an exact open-loop control condition. Together, these results show that a sub-million-parameter recurrent generative policy can achieve strong performance on modern language-conditioned manipulation benchmarks while providing an explicit mechanism for prediction-error-driven online state correction.

</details>


### [398] [Residual Deep Reinforcement Learning-Based Computed Torque Control for a Cable-Driven Lower-Limb Rehabilitation Robot under Disturbances and Parametric Uncertainties](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26739)
*Mohammad-Hossein Fakouri,Ali Keymasi-Khalaji*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种残差深度强化学习增强的计算力矩控制框架，用于缆绳驱动的下肢康复机器人轨迹跟踪。该框架由计算力矩控制生成标称指令，有界DDPG策略仅提供额外补偿力矩，在仿真中显著改善跟踪精度和扰动抑制能力，同时保留模型基控制的可解释结构并满足物理可行性约束。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 缆绳驱动下肢康复机器人面临模型不确定性、外部扰动、关节约束及仅拉力驱动等挑战，导致精确轨迹跟踪困难。传统基于模型的控制器对模型失配敏感，而纯学习控制缺乏透明性且难以处理约束。研究者希望在两者之间取得平衡，即保留模型基控制的解释性，同时借助强化学习提升鲁棒性。

Method: 提出残差深度强化学习增强的计算力矩控制（CTC+RL）框架：1）计算力矩控制生成标称控制指令，提供可解释的模型基控制结构；2）有界DDPG策略仅输出补偿力矩，在标称指令基础上进行修正；3）通过限幅保证策略输出有界，防止控制指令超出物理范围；4）在仿真中设置标称、不确定、扰动、组合及泛化五种工况进行综合评估，并开展轨迹跟踪、关节极限、缆绳需求、工作空间可行性与缆绳雅可比矩阵等诊断分析。

Result: 在所有评估工况下，残差控制器相对于纯计算力矩控制在跟踪精度和扰动抑制方面均有提升，同时保持模型基命令的可解释结构并满足代表性评估中的可行性检查。更广泛的测试表明，跟踪改进可以超越代表性案例持续存在，但也揭示了依赖轨迹的约束限制问题。

Conclusion: 有界残差学习是一种实用的鲁棒性增强策略，可用于仿真环境下的康复机器人控制，有助于弥合模型基控制与学习控制之间的差距。研究结果支持进一步推进约束感知方法及实验验证，以实现更安全、更可靠的临床应用。

Abstract: Accurate trajectory tracking in cable-driven lower-limb rehabilitation robots is challenging because model uncertainty, external disturbances, joint constraints, and pull-only cable actuation can degrade nominal control performance. Conventional model-based controllers provide an interpretable control structure but remain sensitive to model mismatch, whereas fully learning-based control can reduce transparency and complicate constraint-aware operation. This study proposes a residual deep reinforcement learning-enhanced computed torque control framework in which computed torque control generates the nominal command and a bounded Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient policy supplies only an additional compensating torque. The approach is evaluated in simulation under nominal, uncertain, disturbed, combined, and generalization conditions, together with trajectory-tracking, joint-limit, cable-demand, workspace-feasibility, and cable-Jacobian diagnostics. Across the evaluated conditions, the residual controller improves tracking and disturbance rejection relative to computed torque control while preserving the interpretable model-based command structure and satisfying the reported feasibility checks in the representative evaluation. Broader tests indicate that tracking improvements can persist beyond the representative case while also exposing trajectory-dependent constraint limitations. These results support bounded residual learning as a practical robustness-enhancement strategy for simulation-based rehabilitation robot control and motivate further constraint-aware and experimental validation.

</details>


### [399] [MeshPriorDiT: Hierarchical Modeling for Action-Conditioned Cloth Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26766)
*Zihang Wang,Jianming Hu,Shang Su,Hao Huang,Mengkai Shi,Jun Gao,Shuo Feng*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出了MeshPriorDiT，一种层级式布料动力学预测模型，将未来布料运动分解为结构化的网格先验和生成式残差两部分，结合网格GNN的局部物理建模能力与扩散Transformer的全局长程建模能力，在3个布料操作任务的15步自回归预测中显著降低Global MSE。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有布料动力学预测方法存在两类范式各自的局限：基于网格的GNN能够通过材料连通性捕捉局部物理响应，但有限的消息传递范围限制了拓扑远距离区域间的协调，且自回归推演会导致误差累积；基于Transformer的动力学模型能通过全局注意力捕捉长程交互，但缺乏显式的材料连通性，需要从数据中学习局部拓扑响应。

Method: MeshPriorDiT采用层级分解策略：(1) 动作条件化的网格GNN首先预测多步顶点位移，生成一个尊重材料拓扑和抓取约束的参考轨迹（网格先验）；(2) 基于历史状态、计划动作和网格先验，残差Diffusion Transformer（Residual DiT）通过条件流匹配（conditional flow matching）联合生成先验未捕捉的残差运动；(3) 生成的残差进一步通过材料邻接关系进行缩放和解码，以协调相邻顶点间的修正。

Result: 在三个布料操作任务的15步自回归推演中，MeshPriorDiT相较于GNN-Only基线平均降低了43.42%的Global MSE，相较于DiT-DDPM基线降低了75.03%的Global MSE，同时保持了与GNN-Only相当的Edge-strain MSE。

Conclusion: 将网格先验（结构化的局部物理建模）与生成式残差（全局协调）相结合的层级分解架构，能够有效兼顾布料的局部变形合理性与长程协调性，同时缓解自回归误差累积问题，优于单一范式的基线方法。

Abstract: Action-conditioned cloth dynamics prediction requires both locally plausible deformation and long-range coordination. Existing approaches largely follow two paradigms. Mesh-based GNNs capture local physical responses through material connectivity. However, their finite message-passing range limits coordination between topologically distant regions, while autoregressive rollouts tend to accumulate prediction errors. Transformer-based dynamics models capture long-range interactions through global attention, but often operate without explicit material connectivity and must learn local topological responses directly from data. We propose MeshPriorDiT, a hierarchical dynamics model that decomposes future cloth motion into a structured mesh prior and a generative residual. An action-conditioned mesh GNN first predicts multi-step vertex displacements, yielding a reference trajectory that respects material topology and grasp constraints. Conditioned on historical states, planned actions, and the mesh prior, a Residual DiT then uses conditional flow matching to jointly generate the residual motion not captured by the prior. The generated residual is further rescaled and decoded using material adjacency to coordinate corrections across neighboring vertices. We evaluate MeshPriorDiT on 15-step autoregressive rollouts across three cloth manipulation tasks. Averaged over the three tasks, MeshPriorDiT reduces average Global MSE by 43.42% relative to the GNN-Only baseline and by 75.03% relative to the DiT-DDPM baseline, while maintaining a favorable Edge-strain MSE comparable to that of GNN-Only.

</details>


### [400] [Online Joint Calibration of Steering Offset and Planar LiDAR Extrinsics for Wheeled Mobile Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26789)
*Subodh Mishra,Arindam Dhar,Suprotim Majumdar,Naveen Arulselvan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于扩展卡尔曼滤波器（EKF）的在线估计方法，在自行车运动学模型框架内同时估计仓库移动机器人的转向角偏移和二维LiDAR外参，替代传统人工校准，实验表明校正转向偏移可显著降低横向轨迹误差（CTE）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仓库移动机器人的精确转向感知和LiDAR-车辆外参标定对可靠的路径跟踪至关重要，但实际中转向零点常依赖人工手动设定（如通过PS4手柄目测直行），LiDAR外参则从CAD假设并可能在维护后漂移。这种静态、手动的方式在安全关键环境中频繁导致标定错误，引发蛇形摆动和横向轨迹误差增大。

Method: 提出基于扩展卡尔曼滤波器（EKF）的在线估计方法，在自行车运动学模型中联合估计转向偏移和平面LiDAR外参，提供人工标定的原则性替代方案。

Result: 在真实数据集上的实验表明，校正转向偏移能显著降低横向轨迹误差，验证了所提方法的有效性。

Conclusion: 该方法为仓库移动机器人提供了一种无需人工干预的在线标定方案，有效解决了转向偏移和LiDAR外参漂移导致的路径跟踪精度下降问题。

Abstract: Accurate steering sensing and LiDAR-to-vehicle extrinsics are crucial for reliable path tracking in warehouse mobile robots (WMRs); miscalibration often leads to snaking, weaving, and elevated cross-track error (CTE). In practice, steering ``zero'' is commonly set manually (e.g., eyeballing straightness via a PS4 joystick), while LiDAR extrinsics are assumed from CAD and may drift after maintenance. Such static, manual procedures frequently cause miscalibration in safety-critical environments. This paper presents an Extended Kalman Filter (EKF)--based method for online estimation of steering offset and planar LiDAR extrinsics within a bicycle-kinematics model, providing a principled alternative to manual calibration. Experiments on real datasets show that correcting steering offset reduces CTE substantially, validating the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

</details>


### [401] [Rapid On-Robot Learning for Dynamic Manipulation Skills: Robot Juggling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26800)
*Taeyoon Lee,Chunpeng Wang,Christopher G. Atkeson,Alfred A. Rizzi,Nicolas Rojas*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一个在线学习框架，使双手机器人能够在数分钟内直接在硬件上学习多样化的抛接球（杂耍）模式，即使存在显著的sim2real差距。核心思想是：不完美的先验模型仍极具价值，学习应建立在机器人现有知识之上而非取代之。通过正则化的基于记忆的学习，结合全局先验模型与局部经验模型的互补，以及互可达集保证的安全性，机器人在不到5分钟的真实交互中成功学习了五种经典三球杂耍模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人学习多样化的动态操作技能（如双手机球杂耍）通常需要大量真实世界交互，成本高且危险；而模拟器训练的模型存在严重的sim2real差距。作者的核心动机是：即使模型与现实相差甚远，它仍然可以作为有用的先验知识，帮助指导真实学习过程，从而大幅减少真实世界的试错成本和时间。

Method: 提出的框架包含三个关键组件：(1) 正则化的记忆基学习（regularized memory-based learning）：从累积经验中学习局部模型以修正先验，同时保留全局先验模型用于经验稀疏区域的推断/外推，避免无信息的大范围探索；(2) 持续在线学习范式：每次新经验都促使效率和稳定性兼顾的参数更新，而非从零开始；(3) 互可达集（mutually reachable set）安全机制：确保连续投掷和接球动作之间的状态转换可行，不会将任一只手臂驱动到超出关节或执行器限制的状态，从而支持真实世界的反复练习。系统在配备多指灵巧手和机载视觉的双手机器人上实现。

Result: 在真实硬件上，该系统在不到5分钟的真实世界交互内成功学习和组合了五种经典三球杂耍模式：cascade、tennis、half-shower、shower和box。实验表明，即使先验模型（sim2real）与真实有显著差距，该框架仍能高效地利用新经验逐步改进行为，同时保证安全性。

Conclusion: 本文证明了不完美的先验模型在机器人学习中具有巨大价值，学习应渐进式地建立于既有知识之上而非完全替换。这项工作为机器人如何利用模拟先验、在真实世界中安全且高效地持续学习和精化行为提供了新思路，指向了更具普适性的"先验知识+真实经验持续精化"的机器人学习范式。

Abstract: We present an online learning framework that enables a bimanual robot to acquire diverse juggling patterns directly on physical hardware within minutes, even with a significant sim2real gap. One of the most important lessons from this work is that a model, even when far from reality, can be extremely useful for learning. This motivates a central philosophy of our approach: learning should build upon the robot's current knowledge rather than replace it. Our regularized memory-based learning puts this principle into practice by learning a local model from accumulated experience while retaining the global prior model to extrapolate where experience is sparse. This enables efficient and stable online learning from each new experience without resorting to uninformed exploration over a vast space of possible behaviors. Equally important to continual on-robot learning is safety, allowing the robot to repeatedly practice and improve in the real world. We construct a mutually reachable set that allows safe transitions between successive throws and catches, without driving either arm into a state from which its next action would require violating the robot's joint or actuator limits. Together, these ideas enable a bimanual robot with multi-fingered hands and onboard vision to safely learn and compose five canonical three-ball juggling patterns, including cascade, tennis, half-shower, shower, and box, within less than 5 minutes of real-world interaction. More broadly, this work points toward robots that build upon imperfect prior knowledge and continually refine their behavior through their own real-world experience.

</details>


### [402] [CLIPPER: Replayable Shortlisted Optimization for Repeated Spatial Coverage Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26819)
*Julian Teusch,Jörg Philipp Müller,Monika Sester*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出CLIPPER框架，通过候选池、精确增益重算与保守边界触发扩池/审计机制，在保持全约束满足的前提下，将城市级微出行规划速度提升13.6-28.9倍，覆盖率损失控制在0.245个百分点以内。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 城市微出行规划常需根据运营要求（地理围栏排除区、强制保留点、间距规则、区域上限）反复修改方案，每次修改都需要重新生成可行规划。全量贪心算法在城市规模下每次需要数十秒，难以支撑多策略方案的快速比较与迭代。

Method: CLIPPER包含两个变体：CLIPPER-F为每个提案组分配相同数量的候选槽位；CLIPPER-A在各组间共享一个候选预算。其核心机制包括：构建有界候选池、在每次选择前重新计算精确当前增益并检查所有激活约束、用单个候选的覆盖率确定初始排序、通过离线全量扫描衡量池遗漏的增益，并利用保守边界触发扩池或审计。

Result: 在不伦瑞克、慕尼黑和柏林三个城市的实验中，CLIPPER-F在上述策略下完整链路的平均覆盖率与全量贪心仅差0.245个百分点，平均推出时间降低13.6-28.9倍。CLIPPER-A在覆盖率优先策略下仅使用全量贪心9-15%的推出时间，平均覆盖率差距在不伦瑞克为1.82个百分点、慕尼黑为0.12、柏林为0.27。

Conclusion: CLIPPER能够在完全执行所有编码模型约束的前提下，支持城市级规划状态的快速、可重放的比较分析，为城市微出行规划的策略迭代提供高效工具。

Abstract: Operational requirements developed with the City of Braunschweig frame municipal micromobility planning under geofenced exclusions, mandatory retained sites, spacing rules, and area-level caps. Each policy edit requires a new feasible plan; full-set greedy takes tens of seconds per alternative at city scale. We present CLIPPER (Constraint-exact Low-latency Iterative Planning with Pooled Evaluation and Replay). It forms bounded candidate pools but recomputes exact current gains and checks every active constraint before selection. Coverage from each candidate alone sets the initial order. Offline full-set scans measure gains omitted by the pool; online, a conservative bound triggers expansion or audit. CLIPPER-F gives each proposal group the same number of candidate slots. Across Braunschweig, Munich, and Berlin, its mean coverage over complete chains stays within 0.245 percentage points of full-set greedy under the same policy, with 13.6--28.9 times lower mean rollout time. CLIPPER-A instead distributes one shared candidate budget across the groups. Under its coverage-prioritized policy, it uses 9--15% of full-set greedy's rollout time under the same policy, with mean gaps of 1.82 percentage points in Braunschweig, 0.12 in Munich, and 0.27 in Berlin. Together, CLIPPER enables rapid, replayable comparison of recorded city-scale planning states while enforcing every encoded model constraint.

</details>


### [403] [TemporalFlow-VLA: Learning Physically Grounded Execution History for Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26821)
*Jiarui Yang,Yehao Lu,Yuning Su,Yu Zhong,Yufeng Xie,Yazhou Zhang,Haiyu Lan,Kaixiang Lu,Peiwen Lin,Chuang Wang,Junwei Liang,Enyu Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: TemporalFlow-VLA是一种通过物理接地的时间监督学习紧凑执行历史的VLA模型，利用机器人状态、几何和标定相机构造训练专用的"机器人-表面时间流"监督信号，在无需部署时几何处理的情况下，在LIBERO和RoboTwin基准上达到领先性能，尤其擅长长时序多阶段操作任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA模型虽然利用预训练的视觉-语言表示进行机器人控制，但简单地叠加历史帧无法可靠捕捉近期的物理变化。在多阶段操作中，视觉上相似的状态可能因先前的执行历史而需要不同的动作，这要求模型能够理解有顺序的执行历史。

Method: TemporalFlow-VLA通过以下方式实现：(1) 利用记录的机器人状态、机器人几何和标定相机，构建"机器人-表面时间流"作为训练专用目标；(2) 监督两个执行对齐的时间查询，为动作专家提供结构化的历史信息；(3) 采用异步特征缓存，保持单帧级别的服务器端采样延迟，无需额外的历史编码开销。(4) 几何监督路径仅在训练阶段使用，部署时无需显式运动估计或几何处理。

Result: 在LIBERO基准上达到97.63±0.26%的平均成功率（其中LIBERO Long为96.60±0.87%）；在12个RoboTwin任务上Clean/Randomized成功率分别为85.5%/84.2%。在长时序、多阶段操作上的优势最为明显。受控历史干预实验表明动作预测同时依赖历史内容和时间顺序。

Conclusion: TemporalFlow-VLA提供了一种紧凑且物理接地的时间条件接口，能够在无需部署时显式运动估计或几何处理的条件下有效利用有序执行历史，为多阶段机器人操作中的历史感知提供了新思路。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models leverage pretrained vision-language representations for robot control, yet simply adding historical frames does not reliably capture recent physical change. This is especially problematic in multi-stage manipulation, where visually similar states may require different actions depending on prior execution. To address this challenge, we present TemporalFlow-VLA, which learns compact execution history through physically grounded temporal supervision. Using recorded robot states, robot geometry, and calibrated cameras, we construct robot-surface temporal flow as a training-only target and supervise two execution-aligned temporal queries that provide structured history to the action expert. The geometric supervision path is not evaluated at deployment. TemporalFlow-VLA achieves 97.63 +/- 0.26% average success on LIBERO, including 96.60 +/- 0.87% on LIBERO Long, and 85.5%/84.2% Clean/Randomized success across 12 RoboTwin tasks. It shows its clearest advantage over prior methods on longer-horizon, multi-stage manipulation. Controlled history interventions show that action prediction depends on both historical content and temporal order. With asynchronous feature caching, temporal conditioning maintains single-frame-level server-side sampling latency without additional historical-encoding overhead. Overall, TemporalFlow-VLA provides a compact, physically grounded interface for exploiting ordered execution history without explicit motion estimation or geometric processing at deployment.

</details>


### [404] [Active Surface-Driven Reconfigurable Gripper: Robust Grasping and Sequential Manipulation of Thin Objects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26883)
*Ziyi Zheng,Keqi Zhu,Hao Wu,Yanzhe Wang,Huixu Dong*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种集成主动表面与欠驱动柔顺性的新型机械抓手，用于稳定抓取薄物体（以书籍为代表），无需复杂控制即可实现可靠抓取。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 薄物体抓取是机器人抓取领域的重大挑战。现有机械手依赖高精度的接近和抓取运动，导致鲁棒性差、适用范围受限。本文以书籍为例，旨在解决薄物体抓取的稳定性与适应性难题。

Method: 首先设计了一种带主动表面的欠驱动机械手：主动表面拇指可实现在手内重新定位目标书本，无需调整机械臂或其他手指；欠驱动手指与环境建立柔顺接触，可重构结构适应不同书本构型。其次建立运动学模型，确定两种典型场景（桌面平放与书架竖直摆放）的初始抓取姿态。第三，通过分析书本在桌面的物理模型及其与抓手、环境的相互作用，系统优化结构参数和抓取策略。最后通过大量实验验证。

Result: 实验结果表明，该抓手在抓取平放薄物体（包括书本、纸张、织物、塑料薄膜和鼠标垫）时表现出强鲁棒性和适应性，对竖直摆放书本具有高成功率，并能可靠完成长时间连续的"抓取-放置"任务。

Conclusion: 该研究验证了主动表面与欠驱动柔顺性相结合是一种有效解决薄物体稳定抓取难题的方案，无需复杂控制即可实现高鲁棒性的抓取和操纵，具有广泛的应用前景。

Abstract: Robotic grippers face substantial challenges in grasping and manipulating thin objects. Most existing grippers rely on highly precise approach and grasp motions, which limits robustness and reduces applicability. This paper explores thin-object grasping using books as a representative example. Here, we propose a novel solution that integrates an active surface with underactuated compliance to achieve stable grasping of thin objects without complex control. First, an underactuated gripper with an active surface is designed. The active-surface thumb performs in-hand repositioning of the target book without requiring adjustments of the robot arm or the other fingers, while the underactuated fingers establish compliant contact conditions with the environment, and the reconfigurable structure enables reliable grasping of books under different configurations. Second, we establish a kinematic model of the gripper, and determine the initial grasp postures for two representative scenarios (books lying flat on a desktop and books vertically packed in a shelf). Third, by analyzing the physical model of a book lying on a table and its interaction with the gripper and the environment, we systematically optimize the structural parameters and grasping strategy. Finally, extensive experiments validate the effectiveness of the proposed gripper and strategy. The results demonstrate strong robustness and adaptability when grasping thin objects placed flat (including books, paper, fabric, plastic film, and mouse pad), as well as a high success rate when grasping vertically packed books. Moreover, the proposed gripper can reliably complete long sequential "grasp-place" tasks.

</details>


### [405] [Beyond Shallow-Water Photorealism: Physically and Sensor-Grounded Simulation for Deep-Sea Robotics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26888)
*Michele Grimaldi,Enrico Di Maria,Ignacio Carlucho,Yvan R. Petillot*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个基于物理与传感器的深海仿真扩展框架，在Stonefish模拟器上增强了水动力模型，加入随机IMU/DVL漂移、磁力计扰动、高次水动力、地形力学、压力驱动环境变化及物理水下光学，以在实时条件下更真实地模拟深海AUV、ROV、着陆器、ASV和水下滑翔机的行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有水下仿真器偏向视觉真实感而忽视物理保真度，且主要关注浅水效应，在深水环境中相关性有限且计算成本高。不准确的传感器与环境模型会引入非物理伪影和过度乐观的性能评估，对长时导航和基于学习的自主系统尤为不利。

Method: 在Stonefish模拟器基础上进行物理与传感器接地扩展：增强水动力学模型（加入随机IMU和DVL漂移、磁力计扰动、高次水动力效应）、引入地形力学（terramechanics）、加入压力驱动的环境可变性以及基于物理的水下光学模型，同时保持与实时仿真兼容。

Result: 该框架能够在实时仿真条件下更真实地捕捉深海AUV、ROV、着陆器、ASV和水下滑翔机所受的力与测量行为，为深海条件下的导航、感知和自主研究提供了实用基础。

Conclusion: 该工作推进了水下仿真向更具代表性的深海作业条件发展，尤其对长时导航和基于学习的自主系统意义重大，但复杂流固相互作用和完全环境随机性等挑战仍待解决。

Abstract: Many recent underwater simulators emphasize visual realism at the expense of physical fidelity, focusing on shallow-water effects with limited relevance in deep-water environments and high computational cost. In this work, we shift the focus toward deep-sea physical and sensor realism. We present a physics- and sensor-grounded extension of the Stonefish simulator that augments its hydrodynamic models with stochastic IMU and DVL drift, magnetometer disturbances, higher-order hydrodynamics, terramechanics, pressure-driven environmental variability, and physically based underwater optics. These additions are designed to better capture the forces and measurements shaping the behavior of deep-ocean AUVs, ROVs, landers, ASVs, and gliders, while remaining compatible with real-time simulation. This work advances underwater simulation toward more representative deep-sea operating conditions, which is particularly relevant for long-duration navigation and learning-based autonomy, where inaccurate sensor and environmental models introduce non-physical artifacts and overly optimistic performance. While challenges remain, including complex fluid-structure interactions and full environmental stochasticity, the proposed framework provides a practical foundation for navigation, perception, and autonomy research under deep-sea conditions.

</details>


### [406] [Contact-Aided Factor-Graph Localization for Underwater Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26932)
*Michele Grimaldi,Yosaku Maeda,Hitoshi Kakami,Ignacio Carlucho,Yvan R. Petillot,Tomoya Inoue*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种面向自主水下航行器近底采样任务的接触辅助因子图定位框架，将机械臂物理接触作为高置信几何约束融入平滑定位，有效缓解无纹理海底视觉定位中的尺度模糊、横向退化与轨迹漂移问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主水下航行器在近海底采样时面临严重感知退化：俯视相机在无纹理平坦海底产生尺度模糊、横向退化和不一致特征跟踪；惯性-DVL融合又缺乏结构漂移修正机制，导致定位精度不足，难以支持精确采样作业。

Method: 提出Contact-Aided Factor-Graph Localization框架：1) 将吸附式机械臂接触事件建模为高置信因子，在平滑定位中作为隐式回环闭合，无需外观辅助的地点识别；2) 视觉里程计相对位姿因子和地标方位-距离因子根据内点统计进行不确定性缩放，防止弱视觉帧破坏估计稳定性；3) 紧密融合自适应视觉里程计、学习式目标检测与机载传感器；4) 支持运动中的完全在线初始化。

Result: 在水池、海港和仿真环境中实验表明：接触诱导约束显著降低轨迹漂移并提高目标回访精度，优于基于滤波的导航方法和无接触的图优化公式。

Conclusion: 物理交互可作为一种有效的定位原语，在感知退化的水下环境中发挥关键作用，为AUV近底采样等精细化操作任务提供更可靠的定位基础。

Abstract: Accurate state estimation for autonomous underwater vehicles performing close-range seafloor sampling remains challenging. In low-altitude operation, down-looking cameras over featureless planar seabeds produce scale ambiguity, lateral degeneracy, and inconsistent feature tracking. Meanwhile, inertial-Doppler Velocity Log (DVL) fusion alone provides no mechanism for structural drift correction. We propose a Contact-Aided Factor-Graph Localization framework that treats physical interaction as an informative geometric constraint within a smoothing-based localization formulation. The method tightly fuses suction-based manipulator contact events with adaptive visual odometry, learned object detections, and on-board sensors. Visual odometry relative-pose factors and landmark bearing-range factors are uncertainty-scaled according to inlier statistics to prevent visually weak frames from destabilizing the estimator, while contact events are modeled as high-confidence factors that induce implicit loop closures without appearance-based place recognition. Furthermore, the system can fully initialize online during motion. Experimental evaluation in tanks, harbor, and simulation environments demonstrates that contact-induced constraints significantly reduce trajectory drift and improve object revisit accuracy compared to filtering-based navigation and contact-free graph formulations. These results highlight the role of embodied physical interaction as a localization primitive in perception-degraded underwater environments

</details>


### [407] [4DSynth: Controllable Procedural World Synthesis for Dynamic Embodied Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.26947)
*Zehao Qi,Haochen Luo,Jia-Wang Bian,Zeyu Ma,Shuyang Sun*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出了4DSynth，一个可控的过程式系统，能将自然语言描述、蓝图掩模或单张照片转化为可编辑的4D环境，包含显式几何、动画角色、无碰撞轨迹和物理就绪的仿真状态。并基于此构建了4DSynth-Nav导航基准，测试发现两个视觉语言模型在三个难度等级上均无法完成大多数任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 具身智能体需要视觉多样、物理可交互且随时间变化的环境。现有的过程式模拟器能生成大规模交互场景集合，4D生成器能产生视觉动态，但将二者结合仍需要大量人工工作，且结果难以编辑和控制，无法规模化复用。

Method: 4DSynth是一个可控的过程式4D环境生成系统，支持从自然语言描述、蓝图掩模或单张照片多种输入路线生成环境。多条场景路线共享一个基于几何的表示，从而统一处理动画、相机规划、渲染和任务生成。生成的4D环境具备显式几何、动画角色、无碰撞轨迹和物理就绪的仿真状态。

Result: 构建了完全由4DSynth过程式场景生成的4DSynth-Nav交互式导航基准。在三个难度等级上评估了两个视觉语言模型，两者均未通过大多数任务并在早期子任务后停滞。过程式可控性使每个失败可复现，每个难度轴可独立调节。

Conclusion: 4DSynth提供了可控的4D环境生成流水线以及由其支撑的可扩展基准，为开发和评估具身智能体奠定了实用基础。

Abstract: Embodied agents need environments that are visually diverse, physically interactive, and changing over time. Procedural simulators can generate large interactive scene collections, and recent 4D generators produce compelling visual dynamics. Combining these properties in one environment, however, still demands extensive manual effort, and the result is rarely editable or controllable enough to reuse at scale.
  We present 4DSynth, a controllable procedural system that turns a natural-language description, a blueprint mask, or a single photograph into an editable 4D environment with explicit geometry, animated actors, collision-free trajectories, and physics-ready simulation state. Multiple scene routes share one geometry-grounded representation, so the same pipeline handles animation, camera planning, rendering, and task generation.
  To validate the full pipeline, we construct 4DSynth-Nav, an interactive navigation benchmark generated entirely from 4DSynth's procedural scenes. Two vision-language models evaluated across three difficulty tiers both fail the majority of tasks and stall after early subtasks. The same procedural controllability that produces these environments also makes each failure reproducible and each difficulty axis independently tunable. This paper presents both a controllable generation pipeline and the scalable benchmark it enables, offering a practical foundation for developing and evaluating embodied agents.

</details>


### [408] [Arbitrary-Order Hermite Interpolation of Rigid-Motion Jets via Hyper-Multidual Quaternions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27000)
*Daniel Condurache*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文研究由单位对偶四元数表示的有限阶刚性运动喷流的双边插值问题。作者引入超多对偶（HMD）四元数刻画位姿及其导数的时序变换，提出“完整（holonomic）性”要求，并分别在HMD-ScLERP和对数-厄米特-指数两种插值方案中分析其完整性与接触缺陷，通过二阶及三阶数值实验验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 刚性运动（SE(3)）的高阶插值在机器人运动规划、计算机动画和数值刚体动力学中具有重要意义。传统的单位对偶四元数插值只匹配端点位姿，无法匹配端点速度、加速度等高阶信息。将多对偶代数引入对偶四元数，理论上可以同时编码位置及其高阶导数，但前提是插值曲线必须满足“完整”条件（即时序变换须是其位姿投影的时间喷流）。本文动机即在于揭示直接推广的四元数插值方案的完整性问题，并提出满足完整性要求的替代方案。

Method: 作者首先在截断多项式代数R[ε]/(ε^{n+1})上构建超多对偶四元数，证明时序变换及其相对描述子满足酉性并推导递归系数约束，给出允许对数图表下的局部可实现性逆定理。随后将ScLERP代数地推广到单位HMD四元数，证明直接HMD-ScLERP对一般端点喷流非完整，导出系数判据及端点与一阶内部接触缺陷的显式表达式。作为完整替代方案，作者将端点变换映射到对数对偶四元数坐标，应用匹配至n阶导数的(2n+1)次Hermite多项式，再通过指数映射提升回HMD四元数。此外，利用HMD算术直接恢复高阶刚性运动加速度场而无需显式微分dexp。

Result: 推导出时序变换与相对描述子的酉性条件及递归系数约束；证明直接HMD-ScLERP在一般情形下非完整，给出接触缺陷的显式判据；提出的对数-Hermite-指数插值方案在数学上保证完整性。旋转与完整SE(3)的二阶测试以及额外的三阶多项式检验，均复现了所述的缺陷和端点喷流现象。

Conclusion: 直接将对偶四元数插值推广到高阶变换并不能自动保证运动学完整性，需要构造性地将对数坐标与Hermite多项式插值结合，才能获得同时匹配端点高阶导数的完整刚性运动插值。该工作为高阶SE(3)运动插值与加速度场恢复提供了系统的代数和几何框架。

Abstract: We study bilateral interpolation of finite-order rigid-motion jets represented by unit dual quaternions. An order-$n$ multidual (MD) algebra is the truncated polynomial algebra $\mathbb{R}[\varepsilon]/(\varepsilon^{n+1})$; hyper-multidual (HMD) quaternions are dual quaternions with coefficients in this algebra. Temporal HMD transforms encode a pose and its derivatives, whereas a generic HMD curve need not be the temporal jet of its pose projection; we call this requirement holonomicity. We show that a temporal transform and its relative descriptor are unitary and derive recursive coefficient constraints, together with a local realizability converse in an admissible logarithm chart. We then extend screw linear interpolation (ScLERP) algebraically to unit HMD quaternions. Although it matches complete endpoint transforms, direct HMD--ScLERP is generically non-holonomic for arbitrary endpoint jets. We give a coefficient criterion and explicit endpoint and first-order interior contact defects. A holonomic alternative is obtained by mapping endpoint transforms to logarithmic dual-quaternion coordinates, applying the degree-$(2n+1)$ Hermite polynomial that matches derivatives through order $n$, and lifting by the exponential. HMD arithmetic also recovers higher-order rigid-motion acceleration fields without explicit differentiation of $\mathrm{dexp}$. Rotation and full $\mathrm{SE}(3)$ tests through second order, with an additional third-order polynomial check, reproduce the stated defects and endpoint jets.

</details>


### [409] [Riemann-1.0: An Embodied World Action Model for Physical AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27033)
*Haofeng Sun,Jiangbo Pei,Fei Kang,Zexiang Liu,Yaokun Li,Boyi Jiang,Hua Xue,Cindy Zhou,Wei Li,Yichen Wei,Mengyin An,Fanliang Zhao,Biao Jiang,Zile Wang,Yang Liu,Yangguang Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出Riemann-1.0，一个全因果自回归的世界动作模型（WAM），将多视角视觉观测、机器人状态和具身动作统一建模为因果自回归序列，实现机器人策略执行与多具身视觉世界模拟的统一。基于20万小时异构交互数据的渐进式具身预训练框架，在仿真和真实世界操作任务中均达到最先进水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界动作模型（WAM）存在范式分裂的问题：联合生成、视频优先预测或解耦建模等方法未能实现策略执行与世界模拟的统一。同时，跨异构数据源（人体视频、手持工具演示、异构机器人轨迹）的可扩展具身学习缺乏统一框架，限制了大规模具身经验的迁移。

Method: Riemann-1.0采用全因果自回归架构，将多视角视觉、机器人状态和具身动作统一编码为单一因果序列，将机器人动作与世界演化建模为因果状态转移。该方法包含两部分创新：(1) 统一的World Action Modeling目标，使单模型同时充当可执行的机器人策略和多具身视觉世界模拟器；(2) 渐进式具身预训练框架（Progressive Embodied Pretraining），在统一目标下逐步学习来自人体视频、手持夹爪演示和异构机器人轨迹的数据。模型基于20万+小时的交互数据进行训练。

Result: Riemann-1.0在RoboTwin2.0上达到94.3%成功率，在LIBERO上达到99.0%，在长时程组合基准RoboCasa-365上达到62.6%，比此前最好方法高出8.4%。在真实世界长时程操作任务中，SR达85.0%，PSR达94.4%，相比最强开源基线SR提升15%。

Conclusion: 统一的World Action Modeling范式结合渐进式具身预训练，能有效将大规模异构具身经验转化为可泛化的机器人操作能力，证明了因果自回归世界动作模型在具身智能中的显著潜力。

Abstract: We introduce Riemann-1.0, a fully causal autoregressive World Action Model for embodied intelligence. Riemann-1.0 jointly models multi-view visual observations, robot states, and embodiment-specific actions within a unified causal autoregressive sequence, representing robot actions and world evolution as causal state transitions. Unlike existing WAMs based on joint generation, video-first prediction, or decoupled modeling paradigms, Riemann-1.0 unifies online robot policy execution and action-conditioned world simulation within a single model, enabling it to function as both an executable robot policy and a multi-embodiment visual world simulator. To scale embodied experience across heterogeneous data sources, we further develop a progressive embodied pretraining framework that unifies learning from egocentric human videos, handheld-gripper demonstrations, and heterogeneous robot trajectories under a shared World Action Modeling objective. Built upon 200K+ hours of interaction data, Riemann-1.0 progressively transfers large-scale embodied experience into executable robot manipulation capabilities. Riemann-1.0 achieves state-of-the-art performance across both simulation benchmarks and real-world manipulation tasks. It achieves success rates of 94.3% on RoboTwin2.0, 99.0% on LIBERO, and 62.6% on the long-horizon compositional benchmark RoboCasa-365, outperforming the previous best method by 8.4% On long-horizon real-world manipulation tasks, Riemann-1.0 achieves a Success Rate (SR) of 85.0% and a Progress Success Rate (PSR) of 94.4%, exceeding the strongest open-source baseline by 15% in SR. These results demonstrate that unified World Action Modeling together with progressive embodied pretraining effectively transforms large-scale embodied experience into generalizable robot manipulation capabilities.

</details>


### [410] [GRAFT: Grounded and Efficient Online Reinforcement Adaptation for Fine-Grained Robot Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27079)
*Yibo Qiu,Haoliang Ye,Shu'ang Sun,Zan Huang,Ronald X Xu,Mingzhai Sun*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出GRAFT框架，通过区域级监督学习视图特定的视觉锚点，并结合单步动作生成与缓存视觉-语言前缀复用，实现高效的在线VLA策略适配，在四个生物医学操作任务上将成功率提升25个百分点，同时降低在线更新的计算开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略为机器人操作提供了强先验，但将其在线适配到细粒度的生物医学任务仍具挑战：任务成功常依赖微妙的、视图相关的视觉线索，而任务级奖励难以提供关于哪些区域重要的指导，导致在有限的真实机器人交互中难以学习任务相关的视觉基础。此外，VLA推理和基于回放的更新的计算成本进一步限制了在线适配。

Method: GRAFT框架包含两个核心组件：(1) 使用区域级监督学习视图特定的视觉锚点，使感知聚焦于任务相关的局部线索，且部署时无需区域提议；(2) 结合单步动作生成与缓存的视觉-语言前缀复用，加速在线学习过程。

Result: 在四个生物医学操作任务上，GRAFT在匹配的适配预算下将成功率提升了25个百分点，同时降低了在线策略更新的计算开销。

Conclusion: GRAFT通过接地感知（grounded perception）实现了高效的在线VLA适配，验证了区域级监督和计算优化策略在细粒度机器人操作任务中的有效性。

Abstract: Pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) policies provide strong priors for robot manipulation, yet adapting them online to fine-grained biomedical tasks remains challenging. Task success often hinges on subtle, view-dependent visual cues, while task-level rewards provide little guidance about which regions matter, making it difficult to learn task-relevant visual grounding from limited real-robot interaction. Online adaptation is further constrained by the computational cost of VLA inference and replay-based updates. We introduce GRAFT (Grounded Reinforcement Adaptation for Fast Task Learning), a framework for efficient online VLA adaptation through grounded perception. GRAFT uses region-level supervision to learn view-specific visual anchors that focus perception on task-relevant local cues without requiring region proposals at deployment. It further combines single-step action generation with cached visual-language prefix reuse to accelerate online learning. Across four biomedical manipulation tasks, GRAFT improves success rates by 25 percentage points under matched adaptation budgets, while reducing the computational overhead of online policy updates.

</details>


### [411] [Pass the Bucket: Efficient, Robust, Local Load Balancing for Teams of Heterogeneous Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27085)
*Tobias Wallner,Dominik Krupke,Arne Schmidt,Sándor P. Fekete*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文研究了异构机器人群体在无中心控制条件下，通过“桶旅”（bucket brigades）机制实现分散式、自组织的任务共享与负载均衡问题。针对系统中可能出现的混沌行为，作者提出了一种基于局部“令牌”（token）的稳定化机制，该机制在机器人相遇后暂时减速，从而消除持续振荡并促使系统收敛到稳定状态。进一步对比了单边界令牌与双向令牌的效果，并通过事件驱动仿真验证了系统在多种扰动下的快速重收敛与鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 异构机器人群体在协同运输等需要协调运动规划的任务中，需要一种无中心控制、无全局信息的自组织负载均衡机制。现有的桶旅机制虽然简单有效，但系统中可能出现混沌行为（持续振荡），影响吞吐量稳定性和系统收敛，因此需要设计一种仅依赖局部信息的稳定化机制来保证系统收敛到最优分区状态。

Method: 在限定的一维空间中，异构机器人团队通过桶旅机制共享空间任务，机器人仅能感知与邻居或墙壁的碰撞。作者设计了一种基于局部“令牌”的稳定化机制：令牌在机器人相遇后被传递，使携带令牌的机器人暂时减速，从而打破振荡局面。论文比较了单边界令牌与双向（无处不在的）令牌两种策略，并优化了减速因子以加速系统收敛。采用事件驱动仿真验证收敛时间与鲁棒性。

Result: 事件驱动仿真表明：这种纯局部的令牌稳定化机制能够消除系统的持续振荡，使其收敛到与机器人速度成比例的区间划分（即最优负载均衡状态）。在多种扰动下（如机器人删除、位置扰动、速度抖动），系统均能可靠地重新收敛。双向令牌相比单边界令牌在某些情况下能加速收敛，减速因子也被有效优化。

Conclusion: 研究结果表明，基于局部令牌的桶旅机制为异构机器人团队提供了稳健的负载均衡方法，无需中心控制或全局信息即可实现高吞吐量和快速收敛，可作为更复杂场景下机器人协作的基础实用工具。

Abstract: We study the problem of decentralized, self-organized task sharing for a swarm of heterogeneous robots that collaborate in transportation or other objectives that require coordinated motion planning. To this end, we present theoretical and practical results for the simple but effective mechanism of \emph{bucket brigades} for load balancing, in which a team of heterogenous robots share a spatial task in a confined, one-dimensional space, while only being able to sense collisions with neighbors or walls. The goal is to optimize throughput of the overall system, without central control or information, aiming at an interval partition proportional to robot velocities. We address possible chaotic system behavior by developing a stabilization mechanism based on simple local aid, a ``token'', that temporarily decelerates robots after an encounter. This purely local change eliminates persistent oscillations, resulting in convergence towards a stable system state. We accelerate system convergence by comparing a single boundary token to ubiquitous two-directional tokens and optimizing the deceleration factor. Event-driven simulations report convergence times and robustness: For a large variety of perturbations (such as robot deletion, position or velocity jittering), the system reliably re-converges. The results suggest a local, practical mechanism for robust load balancing for heterogeneous teams of robots that promises an effective tool as basis for more complex scenarios.

</details>


### [412] [Active sensing to characterize the heterogeneity of plant stress](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27088)
*Ayman Laaroussi,Peter Hanappe,David Colliaux*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一个自主机器人平台，集成3D植物重建、几何分析和运动规划，实现对植物叶片的目标化叶绿素荧光测量，超越传统被动成像的表型分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大多数表型平台主要依赖基于图像的测量，而先进的植物表征需要整合主动生理传感模态（如叶绿素荧光），但现有系统缺乏自主、精确地进行这类测量的能力。

Method: 系统通过多视角数据重建植物稠密3D模型，基于朝向、可达性和传感约束提取候选叶片表面，并将这些目标整合到任务级规划框架中，引导机械臂末端执行器达到点式荧光采集所需的精确接触或近接触构型。

Result: 该平台能够实现自动化、可重复、空间分辨的生理测量，超越了被动成像的能力，展示了紧密耦合感知、几何推理和操作的高分辨率植物表型分析方法。

Conclusion: 该系统为自主农业检测和植物感知操作提供了机器人驱动的新方向，证明了主动传感与机器人操作结合在植物表型分析中的可行性和价值。

Abstract: While most phenotyping platforms rely primarily on image-based measurements, advanced plant characterization requires the integration of active physiological sensing modali- ties such as chlorophyll fluorescence. We present an autonomous robotic platform designed to perform targeted fluorescence measurements on plant leaves. The system combines 3D plant reconstruction, geometric analysis, and motion planning to localize suitable measurement points and generate collision-free trajectories for a robotic manipulator.
  A dense 3D model of the plant is reconstructed from multi-view data and used to extract candidate leaf surfaces based on orientation, accessibility, and sensing constraints. These targets are then integrated into a task-level planning framework that guides the end-effector to precise contact or near-contact configurations required for point-based fluorescence acquisition. The platform enables automated, repeatable, and spatially resolved physiological measurements that go beyond passive imaging. By tightly coupling perception, geometric reasoning, and manipulation, the proposed system provides a robotics-driven approach to high-resolution plant phenotyping and opens new directions for autonomous agricultural inspection and plant-aware manipulation.

</details>


### [413] [Planning a Shared Modular Fixture Layout Across Robotic Disassembly Stages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27151)
*Haohui Pan,Takuya Kiyokawa,Kensuke Harada*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种模块化真空夹具系统，为不规则形状产品的完整机器人拆解序列规划单一共享支撑配置，避免中途重配置。通过去噪扩散概率模型生成物理启发的初始布局，再经贝叶斯优化精炼，实验验证了螺丝刀和剃须刀拆解序列的可行性，平均经验稳定性裕度分别为66.9%和81.6%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在机器人拆解不规则形状产品时，随着部件逐步移除，支撑表面、质量分布和任务载荷持续变化，为单一工件状态设计的夹具布局可能在后续阶段失效，因此需要在整个拆解序列上进行统一的支撑规划，而非逐阶段独立设计。

Method: 提出模块化真空夹具系统，在混合连续-离散布局空间中进行搜索；利用去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM）生成物理启发的初始配置，再通过贝叶斯优化进行精炼，以在重复的跨阶段评估下高效搜索最优共享布局。

Result: 在螺丝刀和剃须刀的机器人拆解实验中验证了规划布局的可行性；11项定向载荷测试量化了稳定性，实测操作载荷与定向响应的对比得到平均经验稳定性裕度：螺丝刀为66.9%，剃须刀为81.6%。

Conclusion: 结果表明，针对产品定制的共享夹具布局能够在整个测试的机器人拆解序列中提供稳定的支撑，证明了统一支撑规划方法的有效性。

Abstract: Stable support remains challenging in robotic disassembly of irregularly shaped products. As components are progressively removed, the available support surfaces, mass distribution, and task loads change throughout the process. A fixture layout designed for one workpiece state may therefore become infeasible at later stages, motivating unified support planning over the complete disassembly sequence. This paper presents a modular vacuum-based fixturing system that plans one shared support configuration for the complete disassembly sequence of a screwdriver or shaver, allowing each sequence to proceed without fixture reconfiguration. To search the mixed continuous--discrete layout space under repeated cross-stage evaluation, a denoising diffusion probabilistic model generates physics-informed initial configurations that are refined through Bayesian optimization. Robotic screw and component-removal experiments verified the disassembly feasibility of the planned layouts, while 11 directional-load tests quantified their stability. Comparisons between the measured operational loads and directional responses yielded mean empirical stability margins of 66.9% for the screwdriver and 81.6% for the shaver. These results demonstrate that a product-specific shared layout can provide stable support throughout the tested robotic disassembly sequence.

</details>


### [414] [Task-space model-based control of pneumatic soft actuators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27186)
*Nithin S. Kumar,Joshua Gaston,D. Caleb Rucker,Eric J. Barth*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于非最小坐标离散弹性杆模型的实时动力学任务空间反馈与估计框架，用于平面气动软体执行器的闭环控制，实验在三种不同几何形状的执行器上实现1.5-2.3 mm精度和5.5-12.4 mm的中等带宽跟踪误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 软体执行器虽然能够实现灵巧和柔顺交互，但由于其强非线性、分布式变形和动力学不确定性，闭环任务空间控制仍然具有挑战性，现有方法难以在保持分布式力学建模的同时实现实时控制。

Method: 基于绝对坐标带完整约束的非最小坐标离散弹性杆模型，结合稀疏系统矩阵保持计算效率（支持最多10段离散杆的实时控制）。采用准静态前馈逆模型与任务空间PI控制器结合，并通过动态观测器将测量残差融合为虚拟力，从稀疏传感实现全状态估计。

Result: 在三种几何形状的平面气动软体执行器上验证，覆盖五类任务（数字0-9绘制、周期性运动跟踪、跨平台泛化、降感知条件和实时用户参考）。精度运动RMSE为1.5-2.3 mm，1-2 Hz中等带宽下RMSE为5.5-12.4 mm。

Conclusion: 结构化非最小动态模型能够实现平面软体气动执行器在自由空间的实时、高精度、中等带宽任务空间控制，证明该建模与估计框架的有效性和泛化能力。

Abstract: Soft actuators enable dexterous and compliant interaction, but closed-loop task-space control remains challenging due to strong nonlinearities, distributed deformation, and uncertainty in their dynamics. This paper presents a real-time dynamic-model-based task-space feedback and estimation framework based on a non-minimal coordinate discrete elastic rod model formulated in absolute coordinates with holonomic constraints. The resulting structure preserves distributed mechanics while maintaining computational efficiency through sparse system matrices, enabling real-time control with up to 10 discretized rods. A quasi-static feedforward inverse model is combined with a task-space PI controller and a dynamic observer that fuses measurement residuals as virtual forces, enabling full-state estimation from sparse sensing. The approach is experimentally validated on three planar pneumatic soft actuators with varying geometries. Across five tasks, including drawing the digits 0-9 across the workspace (3-18 mm/s tip speed), tracking periodic motion (up to 37 cm/s), cross-platform generalization, reduced sensing conditions, and real-time user-defined references, our method achieves 1.5-2.3 mm root mean square error (RMSE) for precision motions and 5.5-12.4 mm RMSE at 1-2 Hz. Results demonstrate that structured, non-minimal dynamic models can enable real-time, high-precision, moderate-bandwidth task-space control of planar soft pneumatic actuators in free space.

</details>


### [415] [Tensegrity Continuum Robots Enable Task-Adaptive Morphologies for Cooperative Behaviors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27221)
*Mahmud Hasan Saikot,Sydney Spiegel,Sudheera Akalanka Kariyawasam,Andrew Stefka,Josh Chrisler,Jianguo Zhao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种结合张力整体结构（tensegrity）柔顺躯干与爪式连接机构的模块化可重构机器人（MRR），统一了传统MRR的自重构能力与连续体机器人的结构柔顺性，可实现独立操作/移动、多机自重构为链/环/分支等形态，并在真实场景中完成协作操控、多模态运动与移动-操控任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统模块化可重构机器人依赖刚性模块，缺乏结构柔顺性，导致适应复杂环境的能力受限；而连续体机器人虽然具有柔顺骨架，但无法自重构为适应任务的多机器人形态。现有架构无法同时兼顾柔顺性与可重构性这两大优势。

Method: 设计了一种新型MRR：采用基于张力整体结构（tensegrity）的柔顺机体提供结构顺应性，结合爪式连接机制实现模块间的对接与解耦；每个机器人可独立操控和移动，多台机器人可自重构为链状、环状、分支等不同形态以适配不同任务。

Result: 在多种任务和真实环境中验证了机器人的能力，包括协同物体操控与运输、多模态运动，以及真实场景下的移动-操控（loco-manipulation）任务，证明了该架构的有效性和实用性。

Conclusion: 该工作为适应性强、功能多样的机器人集群奠定了技术基础，在制造业、太空探索和搜救等领域具有广泛的应用潜力。

Abstract: Robots that can change their morphologies and behaviors for different tasks and environments hold great promise for adaptable, multifunctional systems. Modular reconfigurable robots (MRRs) can achieve such functionalities by docking and rearranging individual units, but most rely on rigid modules that lack structural compliance, resulting in limited capabilities. Continuum robots offer compliance through flexible backbones, yet they cannot self-reconfigure into task-adaptive multi-robot configurations. Here, we introduce an MRR that unifies the advantages of both architectures by combining a tensegrity-based compliant body with claw-based connection mechanisms. Each robot can manipulate and locomote independently, and multiple robots can self-reconfigure into different morphologies (e.g., chains, loops, branches) for cooperative manipulation and locomotion. We demonstrate the robots' capability across diverse tasks and environments, including coordinated object manipulation and transport, multimodal locomotion, and loco-manipulation in real-world scenarios. These results lay a foundation for adaptable and multifunctional robotic collectives, with broad potential applications in manufacturing, space exploration, and search-and-rescue operations.

</details>


### [416] [STEP: State-Aware Task Estimation and Planning with Multi-Modal LLMs for Human-Robot Collaboration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27225)
*Maitrey Gramopadhye,Prakash Baskaran,Xiao Liu,Songpo Li,Soshi Iba*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出STEP（State-aware Task Estimator and Planner），通过让多模态大语言模型显式估计系统状态并预测状态转移，解决MM-LLM在工业人机协作任务规划中缺乏状态理解、容易产生幻觉动作以及自然语言规划模糊的问题，显著提升了动作可执行性和最终状态准确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 虽然已有研究利用MM-LLM的上下文学习能力在数据稀缺的工业场景中进行任务规划，但MM-LLM存在两个关键缺陷：一是缺乏对系统状态的理解，不追踪状态转移，导致产生偏离目标的反事实幻觉动作；二是以自然语言生成动作计划过于高层，给动作执行带来歧义。

Method: STEP通过提示MM-LLM显式地估计系统当前状态，并预测执行动作后产生的状态转移。通过将未来状态的预测与动作生成相结合，STEP不仅保证规划收敛于任务目标，还提供执行预测动作所需的附加辅助参数，实现任务级规划和参数级执行的整体方案。

Result: 在模拟环境的机器人装配任务中，STEP相比最先进方法在动作可执行性上提升32.8%，在最终状态误差上降低14.8%。

Conclusion: STEP通过引入状态估计与状态转移预测机制，有效解决了MM-LLM在任务规划中的幻觉和规划模糊问题，为工业人机协作中的长时程任务规划提供了更可靠、可执行的解决方案。

Abstract: Effective human-robot collaboration in industrial settings requires robots to understand human intentions and assist with task planning, reducing workload. Recent works have explored the use of Multi-modal Large Language Models (MM-LLMs) for task planning in such data-scarce scenarios, leveraging in-context learning to interpret user actions and generate long-horizon action plans in natural language. However, MM-LLMs inherently lack an understanding of system states and do not track state transitions, often leading to hallucinated actions that deviate from the intended goal. Additionally, generating action plans in natural language tends to limit the generated plans to a high level, introducing ambiguity in action execution. To address these limitations, we propose the State-aware Task Estimator and Planner (STEP), which prompts a MM-LLM to explicitly estimate the state of the system and predict the state transitions resulting from executed actions. By forecasting future states alongside actions, STEP ensures task-convergent planning while also providing additional assistance parameters necessary for executing the predicted actions. We evaluate STEP in a simulated environment using a robot assembly task. Our approach outperforms the state-of-the-art by 32.8% in action executability and 14.8% in final-state error.

</details>


### [417] [Embodied Scene Rearrangement Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27371)
*Canzhi Chen,Zan Wang,Siqi Zhu,Qi Wu,Yixuan Li,Wei Liang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出具身场景重排规划（ESRP）任务，要求具身智能体仅凭以自我为中心的观察和俯视目标布局，在3D场景中重新布置家具以匹配目标配置。同时构建了基于OmniGibson的ESRP-Bench基准（含5,400+场景对、8,200个物体），定义多层级评估指标并提供四种基线方法。实验表明现有方法难以高效完成该任务，凸显了ESRP作为具身智能领域的前沿挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有场景重排任务通常允许智能体访问全局状态，且忽视了真实机器人部署中常见的物体相互遮挡问题。这与实际应用场景不符，因此需要提出一个更贴近真实约束的任务，即不允许全局状态访问并引入物体间遮挡，以推动更具实用价值的具身智能研究。

Method: 提出ESRP任务，限制智能体仅使用以自我为中心的局部观察和俯视目标布局进行重排规划。基于OmniGibson构建包含5,400余对场景和8,200个物体的ESRP-Bench基准，设计三级别指标评估重排质量，并提供四类基线：分层任务与运动规划方法、基于视觉语言模型的方法、以及模仿学习和强化学习两种学习方法。

Result: 实验结果显示，四种基线方法均难以高效完成ESRP任务，表明当前具身智能方法在场景理解和长时程任务规划方面仍存在显著瓶颈，无法很好地将部分遮挡的自我中心观察与全局目标布局对齐。

Conclusion: ESRP是一个具挑战性的新任务，为具身智能的场景理解与长时程规划研究提供了新基准和方向，是通往真实世界智能体部署的重要一步。

Abstract: This paper introduces Embodied Scene Rearrangement Planning (ESRP), a novel task requiring embodied agents to rearrange furniture in 3D scenes to match a target configuration using only egocentric observations and a top-down target layout. Unlike prior rearrangement tasks, ESRP precludes global state access and introduces mutual object occlusions, reflecting the practical constraints of real-world robotic deployment. These factors make aligning partial egocentric observations with the global target layout particularly challenging for long-horizon planning. To facilitate research, we present ESRP-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark built on OmniGibson featuring over 5,400 scene pairs and 8,200 objects. We define three multi-level metrics to evaluate rearrangement quality and provide four baselines: a hierarchical task-and-motion planning method, a vision-language-model-based method, and two learning-based approaches (IL and RL). Experimental results demonstrate that current methods struggle to complete the task efficiently, highlighting ESRP as a challenging frontier for embodied agents in scene understanding and long-horizon task planning. This work serves as a stepping stone toward deploying intelligent agents in real-world scenarios. Project page: https://pie-lab.cn/ESRP/.

</details>


### [418] [FlashVLA: Streaming Action Decoding for Fast and Asynchronous VLA Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27384)
*Zekai Li,Jiaming Tang,Zhijian Liu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: FlashVLA提出了一种流式动作解码框架，通过维护多块不同噪声水平的动作缓冲区并使用分块因果注意力进行解码，实现每个推理步骤产出可执行动作块，从而同时解决流匹配VLA模型的高推理延迟和异步执行不稳定问题，在单GPU上达到≥30Hz控制频率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA模型在实际机器人操作部署中面临两大瓶颈：高推理延迟和异步执行不稳定。特别是基于流匹配的VLA模型需要多步迭代解码动作，现有高效推理方法虽然能提升控制频率或减少执行空闲时间，但缺乏能同时实现低延迟推理与准确、时间一致的异步执行的方法。

Method: FlashVLA采用统一的流式动作解码框架，维护一个包含多个不同噪声水平块的流式动作缓冲区，并通过分块因果注意力（chunk-wise causal attention）进行解码。该分块自回归公式隐式保持了动作连续性，无需额外的未来状态条件即可实现平滑的异步执行，每个推理步骤即可生成一个可执行的动作块。

Result: 在大量仿真和真实世界实验中，FlashVLA在保持强任务性能的同时显著提升了推理速度，在单GPU上实现≥30Hz控制频率，并在真实部署中实现平滑的异步推理。

Conclusion: FlashVLA通过新颖的流式动作解码机制，在统一的框架内同时解决了流匹配VLA模型的低延迟推理和异步执行稳定性两大挑战，验证了其在真实机器人操作中高效、平滑部署的有效性。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are increasingly promising for robotic manipulation, yet their real-world deployment remains bottlenecked by high inference latency and unstable asynchronous execution. This challenge is particularly pronounced in flow-matching-based VLA models, where action decoding requires multiple iterative steps conditioned on the VLM context. While efficient inference methods improve control frequency and asynchronous methods reduce execution idle time, existing approaches often fail to jointly achieve low-latency inference and accurate, temporally consistent asynchronous execution. We introduce \textbf{FlashVLA}, a streaming action decoding framework that addresses both challenges in a unified formulation. FlashVLA maintains a streaming action buffer with multiple chunks at different noise levels and decodes them using chunk-wise causal attention. This design allows FlashVLA to produce one executable action chunk per inference step. Moreover, its chunk-wise autoregressive formulation implicitly preserves action continuity, enabling smooth asynchronous execution without extra future-state conditioning. Across extensive simulated and real-world experiments, FlashVLA substantially improves inference speed while maintaining strong task performance. It can achieve $\geq$30\,Hz control frequency on a single GPU with smooth asynchronous inference in real-world deployment.

</details>


### [419] [CLAP: Cross-Embodiment Video World Models are Zero-Shot Physical Simulators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.27406)
*Kechen Liu,Ola Shorinwa*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: CLAP是一个跨具身（cross-embodiment）的动作条件视频生成框架，通过在多样化的互联网规模视频（涵盖人类与机器人智能体）上训练，实现通用物理先验的学习。该框架通过端到端姿态、语言指令和潜在动作来统一不同动作空间，并采用基于课程学习的训练策略，先在无标注视频上学习潜在动作的物理先验，再将其锚定到真实世界的端到端动作空间。CLAP在DROID等挑战性环境上达到或超越单具身视频模型的性能，并通过少样本适应形成训练视频世界模型的新范式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有最先进的基于动作条件的视频模型通常局限于单一机器人具身，无法利用丰富的异构视频数据中蕴含的可泛化物理学习信号。跨具身学习虽然潜力巨大，但不同机器人平台的动作表示差异显著，且人类视频中通常缺乏动作标注，这使得跨具身学习极具挑战。

Method: CLAP的核心方法包括三部分：(1) 通过端到端姿态（end-effector poses）、语言指令和潜在动作（latent actions）来调和不同动作空间；(2) 提出基于课程学习的跨具身训练策略：先在无标注视频数据上利用潜在动作学习基础物理先验，随后将这些先验锚定到端到端动作空间以实现零样本部署；(3) 通过少样本适应进一步叠加性能优势，用于训练单具身视频世界模型。

Result: CLAP在DROID等挑战性环境中达到或超越最先进的单具身视频模型性能；通过少样本适应性能优势进一步叠加；最终交付了涵盖多种动作条件空间（端到端、语言、潜在）和多种机器人形态（跨具身、DROID、Bridge、双臂YAM机器人、G1人形机器人）的最全面的动作条件视频世界模型套件。

Conclusion: CLAP证明了跨具身训练视频世界模型的可行性，为利用互联网规模异构视频数据训练通用物理模型建立了新范式。其价值体现在：性能上达到或超越单具身模型，少样本适应可进一步提升，并开源所有代码和模型以推动该领域发展。

Abstract: State-of-the-art action-conditioned video models are typically restricted to a single robot embodiment, preventing them from leveraging the vast corpus of heterogeneous video data that contains rich signals for learning generalizable physics. To bridge this gap, we introduce CLAP, a framework for cross-embodiment action-conditioned video generation capable of being trained on diverse, internet-scale videos across human and robotic agents. CLAP is grounded in the insight that universal physical laws govern spatiotemporal dynamics regardless of the actor. However, cross-embodiment learning is non-trivial because action representations vary sharply across robot platforms and are typically absent in human videos. CLAP addresses this fundamental challenge through the following core contributions. First, CLAP reconciles disparate action spaces using end-effector poses, language instructions, and latent actions. Second, to resolve their individual limitations, CLAP introduces a curriculum-based cross-embodiment learning recipe that first learns foundational physical priors across unlabeled video data using latent actions and subsequently grounds them in end-effector action spaces for zero-shot deployment to real-world tasks. Crucially, CLAP approaches or surpasses state-of-the-art single-embodiment video models in challenging environments like DROID. These performance advantages compound via few-shot adaptation to establish a novel paradigm for training single-embodiment video world models. Ultimately, CLAP delivers the most comprehensive suite of action-conditioned video world models to date - spanning diverse action-conditioning spaces (end-effector, language, and latent) and robot morphologies (including cross-embodiment, DROID, Bridge, bimanual YAM robots, and G1 humanoids). We open-source all code and models. Project Website at https://omni-clap.github.io .

</details>
